Retail Project Coordinator

**GoldUnion US – Beverly Hills**

GoldUnion, a global leader in buying and selling precious metals, is rapidly expanding across California, with a goal of opening **25 locations by 2027**.We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Retail Project Coordinator to support and oversee our retail expansion efforts across the state.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working on\-site, solving practical problems, and being directly involved in getting retail spaces ready for business.

**Position Overview**

As part of GoldUnion’s retail expansion team, the Retail Project Coordinator plays a key role in managing and supporting the build\-out and launch of new branch locations. This position is focused on project coordination, vendor management, timeline tracking, and ensuring operational readiness from planning through grand opening.

This is a field\-based role with a home base in **Beverly Hills, CA**, requiring **frequent travel** between branch locations throughout California. A company vehicle will be provided.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and oversee multiple retail expansion projects from pre\-construction through store opening
* Work closely with contractors, vendors, and internal teams to ensure projects stay on schedule and meet company standards
* Track project timelines, deliverables, and milestones, ensuring timely completion of all phases
* Conduct site visits and walkthroughs to monitor progress, identify issues, and ensure quality control
* Serve as a point of contact between operations, construction teams, and external partners
* Assist in resolving on\-site challenges and ensuring projects move forward efficiently
* Support final setup and readiness of new locations prior to opening
* Ensure each branch meets operational, safety, and brand standards before launch
* Travel between locations as needed to support multiple active projects

**Candidate Profile**

* Previous experience in project coordination, facilities coordination, construction, or retail build\-outs preferred
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
* Experience working with contractors, vendors, or cross\-functional teams
* Able to follow instructions, coordinate with others, and communicate clearly with internal teams
* Flexible schedule and willing to travel extensively across California
* Experience in retail expansion or construction project environments is a plus
* Strong work ethic, positive attitude, and willingness to learn are essential

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* **Salary:** $55,000 per year
* Company car provided
* Gas and hotels fully covered during travel

**Working Hours**

* Full\-time, Monday through Friday 10am\-6pm
* Occasional weekends based on business needs and branch opening schedules

**Location**

* Office currently based in **Beverly Hills, CA**
* Frequent travel to branch sites throughout California required

**Recruitment Process**

* Initial phone or video interview
* In\-person interview with the operations leadership team

Pay: $26\.44 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Paid time off

* Do you have experience in project management in retail or construction?

Experience:

* Project management: 1 year (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 75% (Required)

jobs.title: Service Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

Under the direction of the Sales Manager and assigned Project Manager(s), this position is responsible for providing administrative support for the Service Sales Engineers, Project Management Team, and Plumbing Field Team.  



**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

Schedule and Route Optimization


The Project Coordinator acts as the dedicated bridge between Dispatch, the Field, and our Clients. Call centers and dispatch teams are built for speed, volume, and immediate routing; they get bogged down when forced to manage multi\-step, ongoing issues. This role takes ownership of those escalated, long\-term, or high\-tier requests, providing "white\-glove" oversight to ensure complex jobs are executed flawlessly from intake to completion.  

* 

Key Responsibilities


* Take ownership of escalated or complex service tickets handed off from Dispatch or PM’s.
* Serve as the dedicated, single point of contact for clients requiring multi\-step service or project fulfillment.
* Coordinate schedules, parts, resources, and communications between field technicians, internal departments, and third\-party vendors.
* Monitor ongoing project timelines to ensure longer\-term deliverables do not stall or fall through the cracks.
* Proactively update clients on the status of their service requests to eliminate inbound follow\-up calls to the dispatch team.
* Maintain accurate, detailed records of complex cases within the company’s CRM or project management software.
* Board Management: Constantly shifting the puzzle pieces throughout the day as jobs run long or finish early. A PC is always thinking two moves ahead.
* Skill Matching: Assigning complex jobs to senior technicians, while routing simpler tasks to junior techs.
* Equipment Assignment: Scheduling out equipment to techs for high level tracking.
Last Calls: Pushing to get last calls covered.  
* 

Call Triage and Customer Service


* Prevent Technicians from responding without necessary context: Technicians need enough information to mentally prepare for the diagnosis, grab the right tools out of the truck, and approach the customer with the right tone. Ask probing questions during the intake call helps set our technicians up for success while on site. "Plumbing leak" does not provide enough of a description to provide the proper level of service. Technicians need to know the location, severity, and context of the issue so they know what to expect. The Project Coordinator helps fill any gaps prior to arriving on site.
* Emergency Triage: Differentiate between a true emergency and a nuisance issue and prioritize the schedule accordingly.
* Setting Expectations: Communicating arrival windows clearly and sending "on the way" notifications so customers aren't left guessing.
* De\-escalation: Handling frustrated customers if a technician is running behind due to a previous job running long.
Empathy: Customer State of Mind\- (Urgency) Customer is frantic, water is actively destroying property. (Frustrating) Customer is annoyed, possible call back, invoice cost issue. Your role is to discern the situation and handle as a top priority for high level customer service.  
* 

Technician Support and Liaison


* Debriefing: Requiring techs to call or message in after every job to close out the ticket, ensure notes are accurate, and clear them for the next call.
* Logistical Support: Coordinating with parts supply houses if a tech needs a specific part or arranging for a junior tech to drop off a part to a senior tech on a big job.
* Gatekeeping: Making sure techs are on schedule and direct communication with techs and customers.
Safety tool box talk documentation and tracking.  
* 

Administrative and CRM Management


* Data Integrity: Ensuring all customer information is updated (new chief engineer,) property rules and regs, entry codes, and job histories are accurately entered into the CRM.
* Permit Coordination: Assisting with pulling municipal permits for major work like sewer replacements or gas line repairs.
* On Call Calendar: Assigning tech to the on call schedule and managing holiday fairness.
* Backflow Portal Administrator: Entering in all backflow forms on agency portals.
* Track Service Calls: Notify the PM of a service call. Communicate with tech for any follow\-up work or gaps to fill.
* Take and distribute meeting minutes for sales and department team meetings; email recap with action items to meeting attendees
* Assist with onboarding new hires – coordinate with Human Resource to ensure that all first day activities are scheduled in advance, itinerary, meet \& greets, etc.
* Assist the manager with new hire equipment setup; ITPAFs, business cards, key fob/building access, email setup, etc. to ensure a successful onboarding process.
* Prequalification Support for approved RFP's and bids.
* IFS and Bid Tracer Super User – Generating reports for the Sales Manager that tracks individual sales activity
* Monitor proposal and bid activity levels in the three main business segments (Retrofit, Repairs \& Maintenance)
* Scheduling of Estimate reviews with sales personnel and the Sales Managers.
* Scheduling of Pre\-job planning and Risk Review meetings – Scheduling required attendees based upon scope and dollar amount i.e., RVP, SVP etc..
* Plans and organizes meetings for Service leadership, Sales Managers, salespeople and vendors as needed by the Sales Manager including rooms and catering (for both in person and virtual meetings as applicable)
* General administrative duties such as typing and photocopying general correspondence including, but not limited to: letters, proposals, presentations, reports, agreements, contracts, and memos from notes or sending and/or distributing various correspondences on behalf of Project Managers
* Maintain accurate filing system and project document control.
* Take and transcribe meeting notes.
Other tasks and duties as assigned by Sales Managers, direct supervisor and/or upper management  
*

.

**Job Summary**

The Operations Coordinator works closely with the Co\-Executive Directors to support the smooth and efficient day\-to\-day operations of Young \& Healthy. This role is integral to ensuring organizational effectiveness and includes a wide range of responsibilities across multiple functions. Key duties involve managing administrative processes, supporting human resources activities such as onboarding and maintaining personnel records, assisting with financial tasks including expense tracking and invoice processing, and overseeing general office services to ensure a well\-functioning work environment. Additionally, the Operations Coordinator is responsible for coordinating facilities management, including vendor relations, supplies procurement, and maintaining a safe and organized workspace. This position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of professionalism and discretion.

**I. Organizational Operations**

a. Supports the Co\-Executive Directors in ensuring smooth and efficient daily operations across the organization.

b. Contributes to the management and oversight of office operations, policy development, and implementation.

c. Oversee the maintenance of office space, equipment, technology, inventory, and supplies to ensure a functional and professional work environment.

d. Acts as the primary liaison with the IT consultant to maintain open communication, ensure system functionality, and resolve technical issues promptly.

e. Manages the organization’s master calendar, internal filing systems, and routine correspondence to support operational efficiency.

f. Maintains and monitors compliance with all required permits, licenses, state and federal nonprofit registrations, and organizational policies.

g. Oversee the organizational manual to ensure accounting and personnel policies and procedures are current and properly implemented.

**II. Financial Oversight**

a. Serve as the secondary liaison between Young \& Healthy and financial institutions, auditors, accountants, and vendors.

b. Distributes monthly financial reports, reconciles credit card charges and initiates Bill/Divvy transactions. Coordinates with the accountant to ensure accurate financial records.

c. Manages routine financial operations such as weekly deposits, remote deposit capture, accounts payable support, and tracking the organization’s supply budget.

**III. Human Resources**

Coordinates the following human resource functions:

a. Supports the management and maintenance of the employee policies and procedures handbook.

b. Oversee employee recruitment and onboarding with Young \& Healthy staff as appropriate.

c. In collaboration with the Co\-Executive Directors, helps in the development and implementation of policies and procedures.

d. Assists in ensuring organizational practices follow California law

e. May assist in the offboarding process

f. May coordinate insurance benefits for new hires and expedite individual insurance policy changes requested by employees

**IV. Professional Development** 

Continuously maintain and update a knowledge base of relevant skills and best practices pertaining to the fiscal, human resources, and operations responsibilities of the position.

**Qualifications:** The qualifications described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made upon request to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

**1\. Education / Experience**

a. B.A. or B.S. preferred; an equivalent combination of education and experience will be accepted.

b. A minimum of 3 years of employment with a non\-profit agency.

**2\. Special knowledge, skills, abilities, or experience desired**

a. Understanding of financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and compliance.

b. Experience using Excel, QuickBooks or other bookkeeping software, and Microsoft Office Suite.

c. Strong written and oral communication skills

d. Ability to fluently read, write, and speak English and Spanish

**3\. Desired Traits**

a. Commitment to maintaining the highest ethical standards

b. Strategic thinking and visioning

c. Leadership and team management

d. Relationship builder

e. Adaptability and ability to effectively manage change

f. Problem\-solving and decision\-making

g. Emotional intelligence and empathy

h. Innovative spirit and commitment to continuous improvement

i. Ability to work with diverse populations

j. Strong and positive interpersonal skills, excellent customer service skills

**4\. Physical Requirements**

a. Must be able to speak and hear

b. Must be able to lift 20 pounds

c. Must have sufficient stamina to work long hours, sit or stand for long periods, and concentrate for long periods of time

d. Evening and weekend work may be required

**ABOUT AERO**  

At Aero, we believe that exceptional journeys start with exceptional people. Inspired by the golden age of aviation, we’re redefining air travel with a modern approach. Our direct, premium flights via private terminals deliver the comfort of low\-contact travel and the effortlessly fabulous experience of flying private. Just as we create an elevated experience for our guests, we invest in creating the same for our people—prioritizing transparency, support, accountability and fulfillment to foster a culture of trust and purpose. **ABOUT THIS ROLE**

You'll support our non\-profit partnerships and fundraising activations, help execute brand activations on and off site, design the assets that bring campaigns to life, and handle our day\-to\-day community on social media. Running through all of it, you're the person who keeps the team in sync, tracking the timelines and keeping projects moving so nothing slips.

* Keep marketing campaigns, projects, and cross\-functional work moving and on track from kickoff through delivery, maintaining Asana as the team's source of truth and keeping marketing calendars and timelines current so both Aero and external partner deliverables land on schedule.

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high\-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next\-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory\-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. As part of the Business organization, People and Talent attracts, develops, and supports the exceptional individuals who drive Valar's success. The team partners across the company to build a high\-performing organization through recruiting, employee development, engagement, and people operations.


**The Role**



We're seeking a Recruiting Coordinator to support our Talent team and own the logistics, coordination, and candidate experience across the hiring process. This role is critical to our ability to scale—ensuring candidates move quickly, interviews run seamlessly, and every interaction reflects the high bar we set for our team. We're looking for someone who's energized by ambiguity, excited to build from the ground up, and quick to take initiative. This is a fully on\-site role based at our Torrance, CA headquarters.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Schedule phone, video, and onsite interviews across multiple teams and time zones with speed and accuracy.
* Deliver a high\-quality candidate experience through clear communication, attention to detail, and confident onsite hosting.
* Maintain accurate candidate records and workflows in our Applicant Tracking System (Greenhouse).
* Coordinate candidate travel (flights, hotels, transportation) and support expense reconciliation.
* Improve recruiting operations through process enhancements and special projects.
* Build strong, professional relationships with candidates and internal stakeholders.
* Partner closely with recruiters and hiring teams across the business to keep the hiring process moving.


**Basic Qualifications**


* Experience managing complex calendars and using tools such as Outlook and Microsoft Office.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer\-service mindset.
* High level of organization with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.
* Based in or willing to relocate to Torrance, CA.


**Preferred Skills and Experience**


* 2\+ years of experience in recruiting coordination, talent operations, or HR coordination.
* Experience using Greenhouse or a similar Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Bachelor's degree.
* Experience improving or streamlining recruiting or operational processes.


**What We Offer**


* Competitive base salary
* Equity ownership in a rapidly growing advanced energy company
* Comprehensive medical benefits
* Unlimited PTO
* Free daily lunch and dinner provided onsite
* Generous PPE stipend
* High\-impact startup environment with significant ownership and autonomy
* Opportunities for rapid career growth and internal advancement
* Direct collaboration with experienced operators, engineers, and industry leaders
* The opportunity to help build and scale transformative energy technology from the ground up

**Sales Operations Coordinator****Location:** Southern California  

**Company:** The Jankovich Company **About The Jankovich Company**


Founded in 1933, The Jankovich Company is a family\-operated petroleum and lubricants distributor serving customers throughout Southern California. For more than 90 years, we have built a reputation for safety, reliability, and exceptional customer service across our marine, commercial, industrial, transportation, and government markets.


Headquartered in San Pedro, California, The Jankovich Company provides marine fueling, petroleum transportation, barge operations, bulk fuel distribution, lubricant sales, cardlock fueling services, and specialty petroleum products.


As part of the NorthStar Energy family of companies, The Jankovich Company combines the responsiveness and relationships of a local business with the resources, expertise, and support of a larger organization. We remain committed to our core values of safety, integrity, sustainability, and service while continuing to support the communities and industries that depend on us every day.

**About the Position**


The Sales Operations Coordinator provides administrative, systems, and operational support to our Sales Department and helps coordinate the information and activities necessary to support our customers and sales team.

 **We Require That You Have:**

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage changing priorities.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively across departments.

jobs.title: Medical Case Worker II (Outreach Coordinator) N391
jobs.description:
**Salary Range: $24\.33\-$35\.11 per hour**


**SUMMARY**



The Los Angeles County Department of Homeless Services and Housing (HSH)consolidates our countywide response to homelessness. The driving force behind HSH is increasing accountability and transparency, improving care for people experiencing or at risk of homelessness, and streamlining collaboration with partners including services providers, the County’s 88 cities, and unincorporated areas to deliver high\-quality, life\-saving care. Staff schedules are based on business need and may include the option of a hybrid work schedule where employees work remotely and from the office.



The Homeless Prevention Unit (HPU) is a collaborative effort between HSH, California Policy Lab (CPL) and the Department of Mental Health (DMH). The HPU proactively identifies individuals who are most at risk of homelessness through predictive analytics and provides them with flexible, early interventions to resolve issues that might lead to loss of their housing. HPU is expanding to serve young adults between the ages of 18\-24 in need of proactive homelessness prevention resources. The HPU has significant interactions with several County departments to address challenges navigating service systems and/or to connect or re\-connect individuals to services to ensure housing stability; therefore, the ideal candidate will be knowledgeable in mainstream and specific programs and services tailored to young people at risk of or experiencing homelessness while being flexible to meet the changing needs and demands of the program and this population.



The Medical Case Worker II (Outreach Coordinator) position will perform full\-time proactive outreach for the HPU and will report to the Outreach Program Manager. Working closely with the TAY Case Managers and other HPU supporting staff, this position will be responsible for outreaching to and engaging with prospective clients who are identified as at high risk of experiencing homelessness. The Medical Case Worker II will conduct outreach, gather consents from prospective clients and facilitate warm hand\-offs for long\-term care to HPU Case Managers.


**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**


**Outreach**

* Provides outreach and engagement services to HPU clients in collaboration with Outreach Program Manager and other HPU staff.
* Oversees the coordination of new client assignments, intake, and care coordination with case managers, ensuring a smooth transition from intake process to assessment and enrollment.
* Collaborates with case managers, as needed, by identifying linkages, immediate needs gathering and submitting necessary documentation from clients pre\-enrollment.
* Triages and assesses HPU clients to determine their immediate safety needs as well as appropriate population.
* Reviews DMH and Department of Homeless Services and Housing (HSH) medical records/databases to determine service history and contact information and coordinate with current service providers as appropriate.
* Identifies potential immediate interventions for early\-stage HPU clients and link them to the resources needed to ensure housing retention including sources of income, short term rental assistance and assistance with arrears or utilities as well as medical, mental health and substance use providers as appropriate and food, clothing, transportation and vocational resources.
* Provides HPU clients with crisis intervention support as needed including assisting clients to access emergency and crisis stabilization services such as the DMH Psychiatric Mobile Response Team (PMRT), mental health urgent care services, medical and/or substance use disorder services.
* Collaborates with HPU clients and family members (when appropriate) to develop and amend treatment plan goals.


**Data \& Project Management**


* Manages and maintains monthly outreach data entry, documentation, and client reassignments.
* Supports Outreach Program manager in the planning of monthly outreach and new client engagement for Case Manager teams work with single adults, families and Transitional Aged Youth (TAY).
* Completes and submits all required documentation in a timely manner to ensure client progress is monitored and outcomes collected.
* Collaborates and coordinates with HPU management to identify and discuss programmatic and data needs as well as obtain consultation as needed on the appropriate level of interventions/services needed to support clients.
* Other duties as assigned.


**JOB QUALIFICATIONS**



One year of experience as a Medical Case Worker I \- OR \- A Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university and one year of professional casework experience interviewing, counseling, and assisting patients/clients with social problems.


**Certificates/Licenses/Clearances**


* A valid California Class C Driver License or the ability to utilize an alternative method of transportation when needed to carry out job\-related essential functions.
* Successful clearance of the Live Scan process with the County of Los Angeles.
* Health clearance required.


**Other Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities**


* Knowledgeable of community, mental health, and mainstream systems and the variety of programs offered by each to assist those most at risk of experiencing homelessness.
* Highly motivated self\-starter, with proven ability to develop creative solutions.
* Ability to coordinate projects and competing priorities in a high\-pressure, face paced and time sensitive environment.
* Ability to interact and work closely with a diverse clientele.
* Demonstrated experience interviewing clients, individuals, and families to collect data to determine what services are needed.
* Demonstrated experience in linking clients, individuals, and families to specific healthcare, mental health and community\-based programs.
* Knowledge of evidence\-based practices such as trauma informed care, motivational interviewing, de\-escalation and cognitive behavioral interventions.

jobs.description:
**Los Angeles, CA \| Remote \| Flexible Schedule**

Flexible opportunity for social, outgoing people who enjoy meeting new people and are comfortable using Instagram, Bumble BFF, and other outreach methods. Strong Brand Ambassadors can earn **$600–$850\+ per month** with around **15–20 hours of outreach per month**.

**ABOUT THE COMPANY** 

Tribe is a social platform designed to help people meet new people and discover their city through small, hosted experiences around Los Angeles.

We’re looking for outgoing, resourceful Brand Ambassadors to help us grow the Tribe community by actively finding, reaching out to, and bringing new people into Tribe.

This role is especially well suited for current college students and recent graduates in Los Angeles, including students at UCLA, USC, SMC, LMU, and other local schools, who are social, well\-connected, and looking for a flexible way to earn money on their own schedule.

**THE ROLE**

Your primary goal is simple: bring new, qualified members into Tribe.

You’ll have flexibility in how you recruit, including:

* Instagram outreach
* Bumble BFF
* Social media
* Other creative outreach methods

You are expected to work toward a baseline of 10 qualified members per month.

A qualified member is someone you recruit who creates a Tribe account and attends their first Tribe gathering.

**COMPENSATION**

This is a performance\-based independent contractor role.

You’ll earn $15 for every qualified member you recruit.

**Monthly Earnings \+ Performance Bonuses:**

* 10 qualified members: $150
* 20 qualified members: $300 base \+ $100 bonus \= $400
* 30 qualified members: $450 base \+ $150 bonus \= $600
* 40 qualified members: $600 base \+ $250 bonus \= $850
* 50 qualified members: $750 base \+ $400 bonus \= $1,150

We expect most active Brand Ambassadors to spend around **15 hours per month** recruiting, with monthly earnings typically ranging from **$600–$850 depending on performance.**

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

You may be a great fit if you:

* Are social and comfortable reaching out to new people
* Are willing to do cold outreach and start conversations with people you don’t already know
* Are comfortable using platforms such as Instagram and Bumble BFF
* Are self\-motivated and comfortable working independently

Previous sales, marketing, or content experience is not required.

**APPLICATION PROCESS**

Selected applicants will complete:

* A short interview
* A brief training
* A short onboarding call to review the role and get started

If you’re social, resourceful, and excited about helping build a real\-world community in Los Angeles, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
#### **About this Position**

At Henkel, you’ll be part of an organization that’s shaping the future through innovation, sustainability and collaboration. With our trusted brands like Persil®, ‘all®, Loctite®, Snuggle®, and Schwarzkopf® and our cutting\-edge technologies, you’ll have countless opportunities to explore new paths and grow.
  

  

This position is with our Adhesive Technologies business unit – where we empower our people to transform industries and provide our customers with a competitive advantage through adhesives, sealants and functional coatings.
  

  

Dare to learn new skills, advance in your career and make an impact at Henkel.  

  

#### **What you´ll do**

* Generate and qualify leads for subsequent development. This includes providing technical presentations to structural engineering firms, conducting face to face meetings, and attending industry meetings and conferences.
* Manage the business development effort. With the support of management, define and execute sales strategies and tactics to meet or exceed annual sales plans and quotas.
* Collaborate with internal engineering team and external clients to develop innovative strengthening and repair solutions.
* Perform key account planning to identify, develop, and close business opportunities in support of business plan and strategic objectives. Maintain favorable business relationships with key accounts (structural engineers, general contractors and certified applicators).
* Cultivate a comprehensive understanding of the technical solutions offered by Fyfe’s Tyfo products and services. Conduct sales calls and make product / service presentations to meet customer needs.
* Review and understand bid documents on opportunities pursued in territory. Provide input into the design process, optimize pricing, and develop relationships to acquire and execute profitable orders.
* Fully utilize company CRM (SalesForce) to provide accurate forecasting and resource allocation.
* Generate market and competitor intelligence and perform market analysis to drive territory sales growth.
* Develop technical specifications that support product position, proper bidding requirements and ensures successful project completion.
* Spearhead management of customer service and achieve customer satisfaction. Ensure prompt investigation of client concerns and provide problem resolutions or referral to appropriate personnel.
* Remain current on sales performance and provide sales reports as required. Provide ongoing status reports to detail activity to include factored sales forecast, orders report, and backlog report.


#### **What makes you a good fit**

* Bachelor of Science degree in Civil or Structural Engineering, PE accreditation highly desirable.
* 3\+ years’ experience as a Consulting Engineer in structural engineering environment.
* A genuine interest in learning to sell and serving clients. Competitive and achievement oriented. Self\-motivated and a self\-starter.
* Trainable \& coachable in professional selling techniques.
* Client focused and strong structural engineering background.
* Ability to work with presentation software.
* Microsoft Office skills (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint) required.
* Ability to travel up to 50% by automobile and airplane required.

#### **Some benefits of joining Henkel**

* Health Insurance: affordable plans for medical, dental, vision and wellbeing starting on day 1
* Work\-Life Balance: Paid time off including sick, vacation, holiday and volunteer time, flexible \& hybrid work policies (depending on role), and vacation buy / sell program
* Financial: 401k matching, employee share plan with voluntary investment and Henkel matching shares, annual performance bonus, service awards and student loan reimbursement
* Family Support: 12\-week gender neutral parental leave (up to 20 weeks for parents giving birth), fertility support, adoption \& surrogacy reimbursement, discounted child and elderly care, and scholarships
* Career Growth: diverse national and international growth opportunities, access to thousands of skills development courses, and tuition reimbursement


The salary range for this role is $120,000\.00 and $155,000\.00\. This range represents the good‑faith minimum and maximum wages the Company reasonably expects to offer for this role at the time of posting. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for incentive pay or other forms of compensation, as applicable. The Company also offers a comprehensive benefits package as described above. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as the candidate’s skills, experience, education, training, and work location. This posting is intended to comply with all applicable state and local pay transparency laws.  

  

Henkel does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or employment agencies. Unsolicited referrals and resumes are considered Henkel property and therefore, Henkel will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited referral.  

  

At Henkel, we come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe the uniqueness of all our employees is the power in us. Henkel is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, and other legally protected categories.

jobs.title: TikTok Shop Account Manager - Los Angeles
jobs.description:
### **About Spotlight Media**


Spotlight Media is a leading TikTok Shop Partner agency, scaling some of the most recognizable brands in the new age of social commerce. Unlike traditional agencies, we don’t believe in cookie\-cutter playbooks—every strategy we craft is custom\-built to unlock our clients’ full potential on TikTok Shop. As a TikTok Shop–only agency, our entire focus, from the initiatives we pursue to the talent we hire, is singularly dedicated to driving growth on the platform.


We’ve guided brands through the full funnel\- from launch to scaling into the millions in GMV\-and we’re just getting started.


We believe the future of e\-commerce is social. That’s why we’re building a team of high\-agency individuals who thrive on ownership, autonomy, and speed. Spotlight is not just a place to execute campaigns—it’s a blank canvas where ambitious people can build real leverage, take on increasing responsibility, and grow into senior operators quickly. Our culture is high\-performing, entrepreneurial, and unapologetically ambitious.


Join us, and you’ll have the trust, resources, and runway to redefine what’s possible for the world’s leading brands.

  

### **Role Overview**


We're looking for an **Account Manager** **based in Los Angeles**. This will be a **remote role** but due to our client needs you need to be based in Los Angeles.
  

  

You’ll be the execution engine for TikTok Shop accounts, working directly under a Senior Account Manager. You’ll help translate strategy into action, keep projects moving, maintain shop health, and deliver consistent, high\-quality execution across teams.


This is a **learn\-by\-doing role** designed for high\-agency operators who want to grow fast. Early on, you’ll focus on execution and account operations. As you demonstrate judgment, reliability, and ownership, your scope will expand into growth initiatives, client leadership, and strategy\-**with a clear path to Senior Account Manager typically within 6–12 months** for strong performers.

  

### **What You’ll Do**


Client Operations \& Communication

* Run the account operating rhythm: prep agendas, take notes, track action items, and send crisp recaps for WBRs/MBRs/QBRs.
* Build and maintain 30\-60\-90 day plans for each client; update owners, timelines, and success metrics weekly.
* Draft client updates and deck slides; translate performance data into clear narratives and concrete next steps.
* Manage tickets and issues, chase dependencies, and keep all stakeholders aligned and on timeline.


TikTok Shop Execution \& Health

* Own day\-to\-day Seller Center hygiene: PDP checks (titles, attributes, images), catalog updates, and compliance follow\-ups.
* Monitor and report account\-health metrics (e.g., Late Dispatch Rate, Valid Tracking Rate, cancellations/refunds) and flag risks early.
* Launch and coordinate promotions (bundles, coupons, seasonal events) with Content and Media teams.
* Support troubleshooting for approvals or policy issues by organizing evidence, timelines, and escalation documentation.


Cross\-Functional Orchestration (No Content Creation)

* Write airtight briefs for Content and Creative teams; track revisions against SLAs and quality bars.
* Partner with Media and Analytics on dashboards, UTM hygiene, and weekly performance readouts (GMV, CTR, CVR, AOV, refunds).
* Coordinate with Ops and Logistics on fulfillment readiness and customer experience status.


Data, QA, and Process

* Maintain source\-of\-truth documentation in Notion: trackers, risk logs, promo calendars, and asset libraries.
* Perform QA checks before delivery (accuracy, links, pricing, promo eligibility, compliance).
* Contribute to and improve playbooks and SOPs; capture lessons learned in retros to help the team move faster over time.

### **What You’ll Learn \& Growth Trajectory**

* Shadow your Senior AM on strategy development, escalations, negotiations, and QBR storytelling.
* Gradually take point on client calls, scope changes, and mini\-initiatives (e.g., a seasonal promo or creator activation).
* Expand from execution ownership strategy as you consistently hit scorecard targets.
* **Clear, merit\-based path to Senior Account Manager**, with increasing responsibility, influence, and compensation as your scope grows.

### **Success Metrics**

* **Delivery reliability:** On\-time/on\-brief execution; rework rate trending down.
* **Communication quality:** Clear recaps, fast response times, and strong stakeholder CSAT.
* **Business impact:** Tangible contribution to GMV growth initiatives and promotional performance.

### **You Will Be a Fit If**

* You have a strong familiarity with **beauty and cosmetic brands**.
* You’re a strategic thinker who wants to learn through hands\-on execution.
* You have high agency and enjoy taking ownership without needing constant direction.
* You’re a checklist sniper who loves moving complex projects from “idea” to “done.”
* You write crisp, client\-ready updates and can turn metrics into simple stories with clear actions.
* You’re TikTok\-native and curious about how TikTok Shop mechanics drive conversion.
* You get energy from organizing chaos—briefs, timelines, QA, and follow\-through are your happy place.
* You have a builder mindset: you document, templatize, and leave systems better than you found them.
* You actively seek feedback and want to grow into a Senior AM quickly.

### **What You Bring (Requirements)**

* 1–7\+ years in e\-commerce, marketplaces, digital marketing, consulting, or client\-facing operations (agency experience a plus).
* Strong project management skills: task tracking, timelines, stakeholder coordination.
* Proficiency in Google Sheets/Excel; comfort working with dashboards and basic analysis (filters, pivots, lookups).
* Excellent written and verbal communication with a strong service mindset.
* Familiarity with TikTok as a consumer platform and eagerness to master TikTok Shop (we’ll train you on our playbooks).

jobs.description:
**MISSION**



Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we're looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

**POSITION SUMMARY**



The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high\-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.



The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight\-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross\-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow\-through.

**Territory Strategy \& Business Performance**


* Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
* Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
* Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high\-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
* Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.


**Strategic Account Management \& Network Development**


* Identify, prioritize, and develop high\-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
* Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision\-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
* Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow\-through.
* Map influence and decision\-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
* Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.


**Clinical Aptitude \& Customer Engagement**


* Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
* Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
* Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
* Execute approved promotional programs, resources, and customer engagements with consistency, clinical relevance, sound judgment, and full adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.


**Influence \& Impact**


* Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.
* Use high emotional intelligence, curiosity, credibility, and thoughtful questioning to build trust with skeptical, change\-resistant, or highly experienced healthcare professionals.
* Influence multiple stakeholders without authority, navigate resistance constructively, and balance persistence with judgment, empathy, and respect for customer boundaries


**Customer, Patient \& Caregiver Impact**


* Keep patients and caregivers at the center of territory and account decisions, with a clear understanding of the journey from disease recognition and diagnosis through treatment initiation and persistence.
* Support a customer experience grounded in trust, empathy, responsiveness, urgency, and reliable follow\-through with healthcare professionals and care teams.

**Marketing Associate**

**Salary:** $65,000–$85,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Location:** Orange, CA – In Person

**About Hampton Tedder Electric**

Hampton Tedder Electric Co. (HTE) was established in 1958 and is a family\-owned and operated high\-voltage electrical contractor with a proven track record of safe, compliant, and reliable service.

We provide high\-voltage design, construction, maintenance, and testing for overhead, underground, and underwater high\-voltage systems.

We are seeking a motivated, creative, and highly organized **Marketing Associate** to join our team and support the company's marketing, communications, brand, and business development activities.

This is a hands\-on, mid\-level marketing position for someone who enjoys variety and is comfortable working on multiple projects at the same time. The Marketing Associate will work closely with company leadership, business development, operations, project teams, and outside vendors to create and coordinate marketing materials and communications that accurately represent HTE's capabilities, people, projects, and accomplishments.

The ideal candidate is a strong writer and communicator with excellent attention to detail, good organizational skills, and a willingness to learn the high\-voltage electrical and construction industry.

This position offers an excellent opportunity for a marketing professional who wants to build experience in **construction, electrical contracting, utilities, infrastructure, and business\-to\-business marketing.**

The Marketing Associate will support the day\-to\-day execution of the company's marketing activities across digital, print, social media, events, email, website content, promotional materials, and business development support.

jobs.title: B2B Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Overview:
**If You’re the Best at Sales, You Have a Place with the** **Best in Pests**  

As part of the Orkin Commercial sales team, you get the advantage of a highly persuasive pitch: top\-notch service from an iconic brand name and the industry leader with almost 125 years of protecting homes and businesses. That’s backed by award\-winning training that ensures the professionalism and expertise of all Orkin Pros and the Orkin Guarantee that demonstrates our commitment to customer satisfaction.  

This role combines your competitive drive and your desire to be part of a talented team. You’ll have the opportunity to maximize your financial potential with high\-performance sales skills and contribute to the overall success of the business. And you can earn your way to an annual rewards trip honoring top performers, not to mention chart a path to leadership opportunities.  

You’ll have **more than a job**—you’ll have a **career with growth potential and benefits** that go beyond the basics. This includes a company vehicle, competitive pay and a 401(k) program. Not to mention, you’ll receive **opportunities to volunteer and give back** so that everyone has a safe place to live, work, and play. Work alongside a team that values safety, professionalism, empathy, integrity and innovation in pursuit of our mission to deliver the peace of mind only an Orkin Pro can provide.  

With Orkin’s award\-winning training program, you’ll **receive all the tools you need to succeed**. That means no industry experience required to start building your career. Plus, if there’s one thing we know at Orkin, it’s that pests keep coming back, and that makes our industry recession resistant.  

**Ready to start a career with staying power?** **Apply now!**  


Responsibilities:

As an **Outside Sales Rep**, you’ll be responsible for understanding Orkin’s products and services and how to sell them to a variety of industries. You’ll make strategic recommendations to new and existing customers to help prevent pests, uphold quality and safety, and satisfy their regulatory standards. You’ll solve problems and build trusted relationships as an essential partner protecting their business. Adept at listening to needs and clearly explaining practical solutions, you can win over customers with confidence and care.
**You will…*** Prioritize **safety** in all responsibilities
* Conduct yourself with the utmost **professionalism** and **integrity** with customers and coworkers.
* Serve as an **empathetic** problem solver for commercial customers by utilizing the in\-depth training provided to recommend the best **innovative** overall solution for each customer's needs.
* Achieve sales goals through prospecting new business and assigned leads.
* Utilizing marketing tools to drive new business development.
* Conduct an inspection of the interior and exterior of the customer’s commercial property—don’t worry, we teach you how!
* Make recommendations to customers based on your inspection and issues identified by addressing any questions, explaining the solution, and setting expectations so they have peace of mind about their pest program.
* Use the iPad we provide to prepare sales agreements and help you stay organized—we will provide training on this too!

**We Offer…*** **Estimated first\-year earnings: $60,000 \- $120,000 USD annually**
* **Base plus uncapped commission**
* **Company vehicle with gas card after training is completed**
* Company provided iPhone and iPad with sales software
* Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, maternity, \& life Insurance
* 401(k) plan with company match, employee stock purchase plan
* Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave
* Employee discounts, tuition reimbursement, dependent scholarship awards
* Industry leading, quality, comprehensive training program

**Why Orkin?*** You’re seeking an opportunity with career potential in a reliable, recession\-resistant industry
* You have a service\-oriented mindset that leads you to build loyalty and trust with customers
* You hold yourself responsible to commitments
* You value being part of a team
* You want to keep learning, improving and developing as a leader
* You want to join a company that supports the community
* **You want a career with a purpose at a mission\-driven company that values**
	+ *Safety*
	+ *Professionalism*
	+ *Empathy*
	+ *Integrity*
	+ *Innovation*


Qualifications:
**Minimum Requirements:*** **No Experience Required!! Sales experience preferred**
* High School Diploma or equivalent required
* Valid driver’s license required
* Ability to obtain the appropriate pesticide license/certification if required (company paid)
* Ability to work in the field independently and interact with our great clients

**Physical Demands / Working Conditions:**


Candidates must meet physical job requirements and safely perform the job duties with or without accommodations:

* Safely use a ladder within the manufacturer's weight capacity
* Occasionally lift and carry up to 50 lbs.
* Safely access crawl spaces, attics, confined spaces, roof tops, etc. including the ability to climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl
* Wear personal protective equipment (PPE) which sometimes requires an OSHA\-compliant respirator
* Willing to work in different types of weather conditions

 *Orkin is an Equal Opportunity/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities Employer*

**About Thyseed (USA)**

Thyseed is a premium baby\-feeding brand focused on helping parents through stressful feeding needs by bringing their babies high quality, trusted baby bottles and other feeding products. This role will lead Thyseed’s US social media content planning and creation, short\-form video production, static asset production, product storytelling, and day\-to\-day social media platform management. This role is not just about posting content. It is about turning real parent problems into clear, relatable, and high\-performing content.You will help Thyseed communicate with US parents in a natural voice across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest, Amazon, DTC, and other digital channels. The ideal candidate understands how to create content that feels native to all platforms, while still supporting business goals like brand awareness, product education, trust\-building, and conversion.

* Create short\-form video, written, and static design content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Amazon, DTC, and other social or digital platforms.
* Shoot, edit, caption, and package content in a way that feels natural for US parents and social platforms.
* Repurpose content from KOLs, events, parent stories, reviews, and customer feedback into reusable social and ad assets.
* Write ads, product pages, landing pages, and other brand materials.

**Qualifications**

* 8\+ years of experience in content creation, social media management, short\-form video production, copywriting, graphic design and other digital content.

Please submit your resume and a short note explaining why you are interested in helping build Thyseed’s US brand. jobs.title: Manager, Digital Marketing (YouTube – Kids & Family)
jobs.description:
* **Please note** – this is a project hire role with an estimated duration of one year. If you’re an internal employee, please discuss further with recruiter.

**Job Summary**
===============


The Kids \& Family Marketing team drives the campaigns, creative, and content that connect our kids' and family entertainment brands with audiences across every platform \- with YouTube as one key platform. The Manager, Digital Marketing is a hybrid “left\-brain \& right\-brain” role: part creative partner, part producer. This person will be pulled into concepting and creative ideation sessions as a genuine creative contributor, and will also own the end\-to\-end production, tracking, delivery, and performance of that creative \- ensuring assets are produced on time, on brand, and ready for distribution.


This role works hand\-in\-hand with our Marketing team as well as our Programming Strategy team, who own scheduling, publishing, and channel operations for Disney Entertainment Television's “made for kids” YouTube channels. Marketing creates it; Programming distributes it and this person is the connective tissue between the two, making sure creative is conceived with platform and audience in mind, produced efficiently, and handed off with everything Programming needs to publish and optimize it successfully.

**Responsibilities**
====================

**Creative Concepting \& Ideation**

* Partner with Marketing, Creative, and Brand leads as an active creative contributor in concepting sessions for YouTube\-distributed campaigns.
* Generate endemic YouTube Made for Kids creative across numerous Disney Kids brands, characters, IP and more.
* Translate broader marketing creative to ideas tailored specifically for YouTube's format, audience behavior, and “made for kids” requirements.
* Champion strong creative output and craft, holding concepts and cuts to a high bar even under fast turnaround timelines.

**Production Management \& Tracking**

* Own end\-to\-end production timelines for marketing creative destined for YouTube from brief through internal reviews, revisions, approvals, and final delivery.
* Track status of all in\-flight creative assets across editors, designers, and outside vendors; proactively flag risks to deadlines or quality.
* Manage budgets, scopes, and vendor or freelancer relationships for creative production as needed.
* Maintain organized, up\-to\-date asset trackers, briefs, and delivery specs so nothing falls through the cracks between Marketing and Programming.

**Partnership with Programming Strategy**

* Serve as a marketing point of contact for the Programming Strategist(s) who manage day\-to\-day publishing on Disney's made\-for\-kids YouTube channels.
* Ensure creative assets are delivered to Programming in the correct formats, aspect ratios, and metadata\-ready state for full episodes, shorts, compilations, and livestream promotion.
* Align on release windows, tentpole moments, and campaign cadences so marketing creative and channel publishing schedules are fully in sync.
* Work with stakeholders early during concepting so creative is designed with platform best practices, algorithm behavior, and channel strategy.

**Performance \& Creative Optimization**

* Partner with Programming and Research teams to monitor how marketing creative performs once live \- views, CTR, retention, and engagement.
* Apply and communicate performance learnings back into creative development: refining hooks, thumbnails, pacing, and packaging for future campaigns.
* Support A/B testing of creative variants (thumbnails, titles, cutdowns) in partnership with Programming's channel operations.
* Stay current on YouTube trends, kids' content and fandom culture, and emerging formats (Shorts, livestreams) to keep creative fresh and competitive.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Act as a bridge across Marketing, Creative Services, Programming, Production, and Research teams to keep campaigns and YT creative moving smoothly.

**Basic Qualifications**
========================

* 5\+ years of experience in a role that blended creative development with project or production management, ideally within YouTube channel management, marketing, entertainment, or digital/social content.
* Demonstrated ability to contribute real creative ideas \- not just execute a brief with a strong sense of what makes content work on YouTube specifically.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent productions or campaigns with competing deadlines, budgets, stakeholders and vendors.
* Working knowledge of YouTube as a platform: content formats, thumbnail/title best practices, Shorts, and audience behavior, especially within kids' and family content.
* Comfort partnering with editors, designers, and outside vendors to shepherd creative from concept to final delivery.
* Highly organized with meticulous attention to detail and strong follow\-through on tracking and delivery.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to move fluidly between creative conversations and operational status updates.
* Experience working with a major brand, franchise, or IP, and collaborating closely with creative teams.
* Genuine interest in children's and family entertainment content.
* Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, film/media, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

  


The hiring range for this position in Burbank, CA is $95,500 to $128,000 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

jobs.title: OBGYN Professional Services Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**Job ID** 19726 **Location** Los Angeles, California, United States **Job Category** Administrative **Date posted** 09/04/2026

**Job Description**
-------------------


**Grow your career at Cedars\-Sinai!**


Cedars\-Sinai Medical Center has been named to the Honor Roll in U.S. News \& World Report’s “Best Hospitals 2025\-2026” rankings. When you join our team, you’ll gain access to our groundbreaking biomedical research facilities and sophisticated medical education programs. We offer learning programs, tuition reimbursement and performance\-improvement projects so you can achieve certifications and degrees while gaining the knowledge and experience needed to advance your career.


We take pride in hiring the best, most hard\-working employees. Our dedicated doctors, nurses and staff reflect the culturally and ethnically varied community we serve. They are proof of our dedication to crafting a dynamic, inclusive environment that fuels innovation and the gold standard of patient care we strive for.


**What will you be doing in this role?**


Provides administrative support to executive level and coordinates the administrative activities of the office. Demonstrates initiative, resourcefulness and problem\-solving skills in applying a detailed knowledge of the responsibilities, functions and underlying management structure of the department and of the larger Health System in organizing and prioritizing work, establishing procedures and systems and ensuring the orderly and timely flow of business through the office. Maintains supervisor's calendar, screens calls, schedules meetings, takes minutes at meetings, schedules travel reservations, types correspondence and reports; and performs related duties as required. Coordinates/ administers human resource, payroll functions and participates in maintaining departmental budgetary considerations.


**Qualifications**
------------------


Education
* High School Diploma/GED \- minimum
* Assoc. Degree/College Diploma 2 years College degree in Business, Accounting, Computer Operations \& Applications \- preferred
* Bachelor's Degree For EA to CFO: Bachelor’s in Art or Science is acceptable with relevant experience. \- minimum

  

Experience
* 4 years Progressive responsibility in office administration with a background of customer service \- minimum
* 3 years For EA to CFO: Previous planning, finance, and/or business development experience in a healthcare organization or consulting organization providing services to the healthcare industry. \- minimum

  

Licenses and Certifications
* No license or certification required
**Req ID** 19726 **Working Title** OBGYN Professional Services Executive Assistant **Department** OBGYN Professional Svcs **Business Entity** Cedars\-Sinai Medical Center **Job Category** Administrative **Job Specialty** Administrative **Overtime Status** NONEXEMPT **Primary Shift** Day **Shift Duration** 8 hour **Base Pay** $37\.77 \- $58\.54
  
### **Diversity and Inclusion at Cedars\-Sinai**


We are caretakers and innovators committed to the pursuit of equitable healthcare. But health equity is not possible without representation. Our commitment to diversity goes beyond demographics or checking boxes. Our people must reflect the diverse identities, experiences and geographies of the communities and patients we serve – because that’s what our patients, colleagues and communities deserve Quality Care and Research—For All, By All.


### **Our compensation philosophy**


We offer a competitive compensation package for our employees. The base pay range shown generally applies to the greater Los Angeles area and may vary based on work location. Our range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including knowledge/skills: relevant experience and training, education/certifications/licensure; and other business and organizational factors. The base pay range does not include any incentive payments that may be applicable to a role. Pay Transparency Non\-Discrimination Provision (PDF) .


### **Cedars\-Sinai is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.**


Cedars\-Sinai does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of the race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition (cancer\-related or genetic characteristics or any genetic information), marital status, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, age (40 or older), military and/or veteran status or any other basis protected by federal or state law. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at Applicant\_Accommodation@cshs.org and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Requests for accommodation will be considered on a case\-by\-case basis. Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address.


Cedars\-Sinai will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories, in accordance with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring.


At Cedars\-Sinai, we are dedicated to the safety, health and wellbeing of our patients and employees. This includes protecting our patients from communicable diseases, such as influenza (flu). For this reason, we require that all new employees receive a flu vaccine based on the seasonal availability of flu vaccine (typically during September through April each year) as a condition of employment, and annually thereafter as a condition of continued employment, subject to medical exemption or religious accommodation. For the same reason, you may also be required to receive other vaccines as a condition of employment. At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first\-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.


Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.


Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.


Seeking an Executive Assistant that will provide administrative support to an Executive in the Music Industry. This key support role functions as a trusted team member responsible for day\-to\-day administrative and operational activities. This individual will possess exceptional communication skills, ensure seamless execution of priorities, and operate with autonomy.


**What you'll do:**
-------------------


* Provide administrative support for the Executive, coordinating meetings, scheduling, and setting up client/staff meetings, lunches, and heavy calendar management in a fast\-paced creative environment
* Proactively anticipates needs and identifies opportunities to optimize time and impact
* Adapt quickly to “in the moment changes”, ensuring continuous communication and coordination
* Prepare for meetings — including agendas, briefings and follow\-up actions
* Responsible for booking travel, manage reservations, check\-in for flights and be on standby when executive is traveling
* Proactively organize and prioritize daily workload
* Handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion
* Assist with general office errands, support, and assist with various administrative tasks and projects as needed
* Ad hoc projects and perform other duties as assigned.

**Who you are:**
----------------


* Outstanding organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities
* Ability to deliver complex messages confidently — clear, concise, and professional
* Superior interpersonal and relationship\-building skills with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization
* Action oriented problem solver that operates in a calm, steadfast, and detail\-oriented manner
* Proficiency with digital collaboration tools (Microsoft 365, Teams, Zoom, Concur, etc.).
* Ability to navigate within a complex global organization with flexibility and resilience
* Demonstrated ability to manage confidential and sensitive information with sound judgment
* Stay calm and centered during moments of high pressure while maintaining a sense of urgency
* Prior music or entertainment industry experience supporting senior level executives preferred

**What we give you:**

* You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day
* A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best

Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing and Communications Officer, the Executive Assistant provides executive support and organization to the Marketing and Communications Department. The Executive Assistant organizes and coordinates executive outreach and internal and external relations efforts; and oversees unique assignments.



The Executive Assistant must be organized, creative, and enjoy working within an entrepreneurial environment that is mission\-driven, results\-driven, and community\-oriented. The ideal individual will have the ability to exercise good judgment in a variety of situations, with strong written and verbal communication, administrative, and organizational skills, and the ability to maintain a realistic balance among multiple and possibly changing priorities. The Executive Assistant will have the ability to work independently on projects, from conception to completion, and must be able to work under pressure at times to handle a wide variety of activities and confidential matters with discretion.

jobs.title: Assistant Account Manager, Commercial Lines
jobs.description:
**ABOUT HUB:**


In a rapidly changing world, HUB advises businesses and individuals on how to prepare for the unexpected. As one of the worlds' largest insurance brokers, our focus is dedicated to providing our customers with the peace of mind that what matters most will be protected\-through unrelenting advocacy and tailored insurance solutions that put our clients in control. Our growing team of professionals across North America represents a broad, deep and one\-of \-a kind aggregation of entrepreneurs and leaders recognized for their excellence throughout the insurance community.

**THE OPPORTUNITY:**


The Assistant Account Manager provides a high level of support in obtaining, maintaining, expanding, and servicing commercial lines accounts. This position assists with certificates of insurance, policy changes, gathering renewal information preparing client presentations, general account assistance and other special projects. This position will require meeting daily production standards, goals and service commitments.

**DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Assists the Account Management team with all aspects of the account\-service process.
* Responds to policy inquiries via phone and email. May field phone calls from insureds regarding questions about their coverage, changes, additions, payments, cancellations etc.
* Responsible for service work as needed on a daily basis. Including but not limited to the following: certificates of insurance, policy changes and client payments.
* Participates in the renewal preparation process, including generating renewal updates on accounts.
* Assists with marketing clients to carriers.
* Assists with coordinating premium financing and the collection of premiums.
* Checks policies/endorsements and audits for accuracy.
* Prepares quotes and proposals.
* Provides professional, courteous service to our clients, carrier representatives, underwriters, business partners, and HUB colleagues, resulting in a rate of account retention that meets or exceeds expectations.
* Maintains accurate and organized account files by appropriately documenting conversations with clients and carrier representatives; updates all HUB computer systems and automated agency management systems; ensures the accuracy of data
* Performs other duties and projects as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* High School / GED
* 1\-2 years insurance industry experience or equivalent combination of education \& experience
* Property \& Causality License required within first 6 months
* Experience in Medical Malpractice Insurance a plus

**KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS / ABILITIES:**

* Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages.
* Ability to effectively and professionally communicate orally and in writing with internal and external customers.
* Ability to efficiently gather pertinent information and facts, analyze and solve problems timely and thoroughly.
* Ability to prioritize and organize multiple tasks and responsibilities in order to complete assignments on time and with optimal accuracy.
* Ability to respond to customer needs, solicit customer feedback to improve service, and handle difficult or emotional customer situations promptly and accurately.
* Computer skills: proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and Outlook.
* Critical Thinking: Ability to use logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.
* Desire to learn and grow within the insurance industry.

**WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

* This position primarily involves remaining in a stationary position for the majority of the workday.
* The person in this position frequently communicates with colleagues and clients both in person and on the telephone; Must be able to communicate and exchange accurate information.
* Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and computer printer.
* The person in this position needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.

**WHY CHOOSE HUB?**


Throughout our network of more than 450 HUB offices in North America, we offer a competitive, exciting and friendly work environment that strategically positions our employees for longevity and success. At HUB, we believe in investing in the future of our employees, and provide continuous opportunities for growth and development*.* Our entrepreneurial culture fosters an environment that empowers our people to make the best decisions for our customers and organization, focusing on expanding the industry knowledge of our insurance professionals to better serve our valued clients.
