jobs.title: Program Specialist II - Clinical Programs (Respiratory Health/HIV)
jobs.description:
Description:
**Position Summary:**


The Clinical Program Specialist II (Respiratory Health \& HIV) serves as an experienced direct care, navigation, and outreach lead within Roots’ Clinical Programs department. Representing Roots Community Health Center, this role blends clinical program support, patient outreach, care coordination, and health education focused on high\-priority conditions including HIV, sexual health, asthma, COVID\-19, and infectious respiratory diseases.


As a Level II specialist, the incumbent manages larger patient panels and leads field\-based outreach initiatives targeted at eliminating health disparities in underserved, low\-income, and unsheltered communities.


Requirements:#### **Essential Functions:**

#### **Direct Care Coordination \& Patient Navigation**

* Serve as a direct liaison between patients and Roots' Clinical Programs, facilitating seamless recruitment, enrollment, intake, and longitudinal care retention.
* Manage and track large client panel lists, using prioritization skills to schedule and confirm program initiation, specialist referrals, and routine follow\-up visits.
* Conduct patient intakes and comprehensive assessments (both in\-person and via phone), connecting patients to Patient Services for public benefit enrollment (e.g., Medi\-Cal, CalFresh, CalWORKS) and basic needs support.
* Assist patients in understanding disease management concepts and guidelines for HIV prevention/treatment (including PrEP/PEP) and respiratory care (e.g., asthma control, COVID\-19 management).
* Partner closely with internal navigation teams, medical providers, and clinic staff to ensure an uninterrupted continuum of care and share patient progress updates.

#### **Outreach, In\-Reach, \& Community Engagement**

* Conduct targeted phone outreach and clinic "in\-reach" to existing patients to build awareness and engagement in HIV and Respiratory Health programs.
* Lead field and street\-based outreach to engage hard\-to\-reach populations, including individuals living in encampments, shelters, or temporary housing.
* Represent Roots as an instrumental lead during weekend and evening community outreach events, managing on\-site logistics, health screenings, and harm\-reduction education.
* Build and maintain collaborative partnerships with local Emergency Departments, Community\-Based Organizations, and local health initiatives to streamline external patient referrals.

#### **Documentation, Data \& Program Support**

* Maintain up\-to\-date, highly accurate records of all patient encounters, referrals, and outreach activities across Electronic Health Record systems and specialized tracking databases.
* Ensure strict adherence to HIPAA compliance and patient privacy standards across all interactions and data entries.
* Assist program leadership in tracking program and contract deliverables tied to HIV and respiratory grants, identifying operational bottlenecks or data collection gaps.
* Meet regularly with Program Coordinators and Managers for case reviews, workflow planning, and program strategy development.

### **Education \& Certification Requirements**

* **Education:** High School Diploma or GED required. Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Social Work, or a related field preferred.
* **Certification:** Completion of an accredited Community Health Worker certification program (or willingness to complete within 6 months of hire).
* **Lived Experience:** Lived experience within or a strong connection to the communities served by Roots Community Health Center.

### **Preferred Qualifications \& Work Experience**

* Minimum 2 years of experience in community health, social services, patient navigation, or public health programs (preferably within a non\-profit organization or community clinic).
* Experience working with high\-priority clinical conditions, such as HIV/STIs, respiratory illnesses, substance use disorders, or chronic disease management.
* Demonstrated background in conducting community outreach and collaborating with multidisciplinary clinical teams.

**Core Competencies**

* **Non\-Judgmental Advocacy:** Ability to discuss stigmatized health topics (HIV, sexual health, harm reduction) empathetically without bias or stigma.
* **Cross\-Cultural Competency:** Strong ability to connect respectfully with diverse populations, including low\-income individuals, unsheltered communities, and communities of color.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Experience navigating Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems, client tracking spreadsheets, and G\-Suite/Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, Outlook).
* **Organizational Skills:** Excellent time management skills with the ability to balance client case management, panel prioritization, and event planning.
* **Flexibility:** Willingness to work a flexible schedule, including occasional evenings and weekends for outreach activities.
* **Driver’s License:** Valid California Driver’s License with a safe driving record (or ability to obtain).

### **Physical Demands \& Working Conditions**

* Frequent standing, walking, stair climbing, bending, stooping, and lifting up to 25 lbs.
* Gross and fine manual dexterity to operate standard office equipment and keyboards.
* Ability to work both indoors within a clinic environment and outdoors during street\-based outreach or community events.

Founded in 1927, St. Francis Yacht Club is steeped in over 90 years of yachting traditions. In addition to the city\-based clubhouse, Tinsley Island is our private slice of paradise, located 60 miles up the Delta from St. Francis Yacht Club. This 40\-acre oasis is accessed by a Club\-owned launch or private boat and offers a year\-round getaway for our members, featuring dockage and houseboats, on\-island lodging and kitchen facilities, a swimming pool, small boat fleet for member use and a variety of other diversions in a rustic, relaxing setting.

jobs.description:
**About WCN**


Wildlife Conservation Network is a rapidly growing leader in wildlife conservation, protecting endangered wildlife by supporting conservationists who ensure wildlife and people coexist and thrive. Using a collaborative, entrepreneurial, innovative, and philanthropically generous approach, WCN gives conservation leaders access to the donors, resources, and tools they need to reverse the crises facing threatened species — raising philanthropic funding and channeling it to a vetted network of Conservation Partners and through species\-focused Wildlife Funds that support over 125 species in more than 50 countries. This is a hybrid role with anticipated 3\-4 days in office.

**Position Summary**


The Office Operations Coordinator keeps WCN's office, facilities, technology, events logistics, and finance\-support functions running day to day. This is a generalist role by design — the person in it moves across a wide range of tasks and prioritizes what's most urgent on a given day — and it's a strong entry point into nonprofit operations for someone early in their career who wants to grow. Reporting to the CFO, this role supports the whole organization and works most visibly alongside Donor Engagement and Events around Expo and other donor\-facing events.

**Mission, Vision \& Values Alignment**


This role keeps the operational backbone of WCN — office, technology, events, and finance\-support functions — running smoothly, freeing the organization to focus on its Conservation Partners, Wildlife Funds, and Rising Wildlife Leaders work in the field. It lives WCN's values directly: *Service* (the role exists to support other teams' work), *Integrity* (trustworthy handling of financially sensitive tasks like check deposits and petty cash), *Community* (visitor hospitality and internal culture/engagement support), and *Collaboration* (close partnership with Finance, Donor Engagement, and Events).

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Office \& Facilities** — Keep the physical office running day to day: phone coverage, visitor reception, supplies and systems, vendor relationships (e.g., janitorial), and a well\-organized, well\-used physical space.
* **Administrative Support** — Keep WCN organized and staff supported: general inquiries, mail, filing, new\-hire onboarding logistics, shared calendars, and employee engagement activities.
* **Finance Support** — Own the day\-to\-day financial tasks that keep operations running cleanly: check deposits (primary owner), petty cash, vendor invoices and payments, subscription tracking, and monthly credit card reconciliation, in close partnership with the Finance team.
* **Technology \& Equipment** — Maintain WCN's computer/equipment inventory and serve as the primary point of contact with WCN's IT support vendor.
* **Events \& Cross\-Team Support** — Coordinate staff and partner travel bookings and expense reporting, and support logistics for internal and external events, including Expo (storage, merchandise, partner packages).
* **Ad Hoc** — Take on cross\-departmental administrative support and special projects (Development, Programs, Finance) as they come up.

**Qualifications**

* 1\-3 years of office/administrative experience
* Strong general computer and technology skills (e.g., spreadsheets, documents, presentation software)
* Experience with cloud\-based collaborative tools (Google Drive, email); willingness to learn Salesforce basics with training
* Experience answering/routing calls on a multi\-line phone system or serving in a front\-desk/reception role
* Experience coordinating with vendors or service providers (scheduling, ordering, basic contract/invoice tracking)
* Familiarity with mail/shipping logistics (USPS, UPS, FedEx)
* Fluent in English, with strong verbal and written communication skills
* Comfortable with variety and frequent interruptions (phones, visitors, vendors) rather than sustained single\-task focus; self\-directed enough to keep a long list of recurring tasks moving without close daily supervision
* Must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship
* Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds and sit for extended periods, with or without reasonable accommodation
* Genuine interest in wildlife conservation and strong alignment with WCN's Core Values

**Compensation \& Benefits**


Compensation is expected to be in the $33\-36 an hour range based on qualifications and experience. Benefits include: medical, dental, and vision insurance contributions; chiropractic/acupuncture; basic life insurance and AD\&D Health FSA and dependent care (pre\-tax); a retirement plan with a 100% employer match on employee contributions up to 6% of salary; 11 paid holidays plus 1 paid floating holiday; 15 days of paid vacation in the first year (\+1 day per year worked); paid sick leave; and employee wellness, mental health, and discount programs.

**Equal Opportunity**


WCN is committed to the principles of being an equal opportunity employer (EOE). WCN’s organizational policies, practices, programs, activities and decisions regarding employment are not based on a person’s race, color, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, parental status, housing status, or other protected status, in accordance with applicable law. Black, Indigenous, people of color, women, individuals identifying with the LGBTQIA\+ community, or members of other underrepresented groups in the conservation sector are strongly encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Our Mission**
---------------


Reflection is a research lab making intelligence open and accessible for everyone to use, customize, and build on. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all.

**Role Overview**
-----------------


We're hiring a Recruiting Coordinator to own the machinery behind our hiring — the systems, process, and enablement that let recruiters and hiring managers move fast without dropping anything. This is not a scheduling\-only role: you'll get into the guts of our ATS, build the reports that tell us where hiring is working and where it's stuck, and stand up new programs end to end. You'll sit at the center of every hire, balancing the needs of recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates, and you'll have real ownership over how talent ops runs as we scale. Based out of SF or NY, this role is an onsite position and you'll work closely with the recruiting team from day one.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Manage candidate logistics and communications, balancing the priorities of recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates
* Own day\-to\-day operations of our ATS (Ashby) — configuration, hygiene, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement
* Build and maintain reporting and dashboards to inform recruiting decisions
* Design and launch new recruiting programs and tools — run enablement sessions with recruiters, interviewers, etc and act as the ongoing point person
* Identify and fix breakdowns in process before they become bottlenecks
* Keep our talent ops stack (ATS, scheduling tools, sourcing tools) integrated and running smoothly

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 2\+ years of experience in recruiting operations, talent ops, or a related coordination role
* Genuine interest in getting into the nitty gritty of talent ops — systems, tooling, ATS configuration, and enablement, not just scheduling
* Strong communication skills
* Comfort building reports and dashboards, with a working understanding of core recruiting metrics
* Track record of launching a new program or process and driving adoption of it
* High attention to detail and ownership — things don't fall through the cracks on your watch
* Ashby experience is a strong plus, especially having gone through an ATS implementation or migration

**What We Offer:**
------------------


We believe that to make intelligence open and accessible to all, you need to start at the foundation. Joining Reflection means building from the ground up as part of a talent\-dense team. You will help define our future as a company, and help define the future of open foundational models.


We want you to do the most impactful work of your career with the confidence that you and the people you care about most are supported.

* **Top\-tier compensation:** Salary and equity structured to recognize and retain our talent globally.
* **Stock options:** Everyone who joins and contributes to Reflection's success gets to share in the upside through stock options.
* **Health \& wellness:** Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life, with an annual wellness allowance.
* **Meals:** Lunch and dinner are provided in the office daily.
* **Life \& family:** 22 weeks paid parental leave for all new birthing and non\-birthing parents, including adoptive and surrogate journeys.
* **Vacation days:** Unlimited paid time off in the U.S. and 30 days in the U.K.
* **Sponsorship support:** We sponsor visas to help exceptional talent join our team and support long\-term immigration pathways where applicable.
* **Team building:** We have regular off\-sites, happy hours, and team celebrations.

***Export Control Notice:*** *This position may require access to technology or source code subject to the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Any offer of employment for this role may be conditioned on the Company's ability to provide the candidate with access to such technology or source code in compliance with applicable U.S. export control laws, which may require the Company to seek government authorization.*

jobs.title: Care Coordination & Office Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About TLC Nurse Solutions**

TLC Nurse Solutions is a women\-owned California nurse registry thoughtfully coordinating experienced independent Registered Nurses (RNs) and Licensed Vocational Nurses (LVNs) with private\-pay clients and healthcare partners throughout California.

Our Care Coordination \& Office Operations Team is at the heart of that work. We coordinate referrals, schedules, communication, documentation, credentialing, and billing support while helping clients, nurses, and healthcare partners feel informed and well supported.

**About the Position**

This is a hands\-on role within a collaborative, growing small business. Priorities can shift throughout the day as new referrals arrive, schedules change, or a client or nurse needs timely assistance. The right person enjoys bringing calm and organization to a responsive environment, takes genuine ownership of their work, and follows important details through to completion.

Every team member is cross\-trained in TLC's core operations so we can support one another, provide dependable coverage, and continue improving how we work.

**What You Will Do**

· Coordinate new and ongoing nursing referrals, schedules, and coverage needs.

· Communicate professionally and compassionately with clients, families, independent nurses, specialty pharmacies, physicians, healthcare facilities, case managers, discharge planners, and other referral partners.

· Respond to phone calls, emails, text messages, and faxes in a timely and organized manner.

· Manage schedule changes, cancellations, urgent coverage requests, and other time\-sensitive needs.

· Review nursing documentation for completeness and process it promptly.

· Assist with client invoicing, contractor invoice processing, and related follow\-up.

· Maintain accurate scheduling, credentialing, compliance, and operational records.

· Follow written Standard Operating Procedures while helping identify practical workflow improvements.

· Support teammates and participate in shared evening, weekend, and holiday on\-call coverage.

**Who Thrives Here**

People who thrive at TLC care about doing things well, helping others, and contributing to the organization as a whole. They tend to:

· Take ownership, show initiative, and follow responsibilities through to completion.

· Stay organized, responsive, and attentive to details while managing multiple priorities.

· Communicate clearly, kindly, and proactively.

· Remain calm, thoughtful, and solution\-focused when circumstances change.

· Use sound judgment, make confident routine decisions, and ask questions when collaboration is helpful.

· Notice what needs attention and help move it forward.

· Enjoy learning how different parts of a growing organization work together.

· Value teamwork, flexibility, accountability, and exceptional client service.

**Qualifications**

· **Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) preferred.**

· Strong organizational, written communication, and verbal communication skills.

· Comfort managing multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and follow\-through.

· Ability to work independently and contribute to a close, collaborative team.

· Comfort learning scheduling, credentialing, documentation, communication, and office systems.

· Healthcare administration, care coordination, scheduling, office operations, or customer service experience is helpful.

Healthcare experience is valuable, and we place equal importance on judgment, emotional intelligence, professionalism, adaptability, curiosity, and a genuine sense of responsibility.

**Schedule, Compensation \& Benefits**

· Full\-time position starting at $33\-$35 per hour, based on experience and qualifications.

· Flexible scheduling with a thoughtful combination of office and remote work when appropriate.

· Shared evening, weekend, and holiday on\-call support; working hours may be adjusted to help maintain balance and keep schedules within 40 hours per week.

· Health insurance benefits and retirement savings plan.

· Structured training, written SOPs, cross\-training, and opportunities to take on greater responsibility as TLC grows.

**Apply**

We would be happy to meet dependable, thoughtful candidates who enjoy helping others and want to grow with TLC. Above all, client care comes first in everything we do.

Pay: $33\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan

Application Question(s):

* Do you currently hold an active California LVN license?
* Are you available to participate in shared evening, weekend, and holiday on\-call coverage, with working hours adjusted to help keep your schedule within 40 hours per week?
* Please briefly describe your experience with care coordination, healthcare scheduling, credentialing, documentation review, billing support, or other medical office operations.

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Assistant Buyer / Merchandising Coordinator

jobs.title: Event Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Position:** Member Events Operations Manager

**Department:** Member Events / Programming

**Reports To:** Director of Programming

**FLSA:** Salary – Exempt

 **COMPANY PROFILE**


The Battery is San Francisco's premier modern\-era private social club, recognized by the Michelin Guide with Two Keys — one of the highest distinctions awarded to a hospitality property worldwide. Set within a historic building on Battery Street, the Club features seven distinctive bars and lounges alongside acclaimed dining rooms serving breakfast, brunch, lunch, and dinner. The Battery also offers a boutique 14\-suite hotel, including penthouse accommodations, elegant private event spaces, lush gardens, and sweeping views of the San Francisco skyline. Members enjoy a dynamic cultural calendar of world\-class speakers, performing arts, curated experiences, publications, and excursions. Through Battery Powered, the Club's member\-funded 501(c)(3\) foundation, The Battery has directed more than $35 million in grants to organizations building a stronger society — reflecting a rare combination of world\-class hospitality and purpose.

**POSITION PROFILE**


The Member Events Operations Manager owns the day\-to\-day execution of The Battery's Member Events programming, running the majority of the Club's recurring events — trivia nights, comedy, Saturday concerts, and other repeat programming — from setup through breakdown. This is not an occasional floor\-support role; on most days, this person is the operational lead on the ground for whatever Member Event is happening.


Beyond live execution, this role owns the operational and administrative backbone of the department: maintaining the recurring programming calendar, advancing events with artists, speakers, and vendors ahead of time, and handling invoicing and post\-event documentation. This is a hands\-on, floor\-based position suited for someone with hospitality and event experience who thrives in live environments, understands service flow, and can manage staff and logistics in real time. The role works closely with Programming and Food \& Beverage leadership to deliver consistent, well\-run events that meet the Club's standards.


Because this role supports live events and Club operations, flexibility is essential. Hours will shift based on the event calendar and business needs; the position requires regular evening work, including late nights, as well as occasional Sundays and holidays. Candidates should be comfortable working a schedule that varies week to week.


This is an on\-site position located in San Francisco.

**BATTERY PROGRAMS**


Member Events produces a wide range of programming, including but not limited to: high\-end culinary events, wine and spirit tastings, comedy nights, live music concerts, lectures and panels, trivia and game nights, networking events, DJ nights, and family programs.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**


The following reflects management's definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time due to reasonable accommodation or for other reasons.

**Event \& Service Execution**

* Serve as the on\-site operational lead for the majority of Member Events, including high\-frequency recurring programs (trivia, comedy nights, Saturday concerts, and similar repeat events), overseeing setup, service flow, and breakdown.
* Ensure BEOs and event timelines are followed accurately during live events.
* Execute food and beverage service plans in coordination with F\&B and Culinary teams.
* Act as a host presence during events, supporting Members and resolving service issues as they arise.
* Close out the Point of Sale (POS) system and provide receipts and an event recap to the Member Events team.

**Staffing \& Floor Leadership**

* Supervise hourly event staff and outsourced labor during events.
* Lead pre\-event briefings to align staff on service expectations and timing.
* Support training and reinforcement of service standards during events.
* Escalate staffing or performance issues to department leadership when needed.

**Event Management Support**

* Partner with the Programming team to translate event plans into operational execution.
* Coordinate with AV, Engineering, Front Desk, and Security on event\-day needs.
* Assist with furniture layouts, run\-of\-show coordination, and basic production logistics.
* Advance events with artists, speakers, and vendors ahead of time, confirming logistics, hospitality needs, schedules, and any special requirements.
* Serve as the main point of contact for artists, vendors, and speakers for select programs.
* Help establish and maintain strong relationships with artists, speakers, and vendors that come to The Battery.

**Administrative \& Operational Support**

* Own and maintain the recurring programming calendar, including monthly repeat programming BEOs and floor plans using existing templates.
* Assist with invoice collection and coding, vendor paperwork, and post\-event documentation.
* Create weekly event signage using templates.
* Support expense tracking and reconciliation for events.
* Maintain operational notes, staffing feedback, and event follow\-ups.
* Additional administrative projects as time allows.

**Cross\-Department Support**

* Provide occasional support for Private Events during slower programming periods.
* Communicate clearly with supervisors regarding event outcomes, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.

**ESSENTIAL SKILLS**


Must have and be able to do all of the following:

* Demonstrated experience managing service staff during live events.
* Can creatively solve problems and effectively implement solutions.
* Must be able to deal with vendors, presenters, and talent in a professional manner while maintaining a composed demeanor in high\-stress situations.
* Strong communication skills and calm presence in fast\-paced e

jobs.description:

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in a customer\-facing role working with stakeholders, driving customer technical implementations or transformation programs.
* Experience supporting customers in cloud operations (e.g., launch or capacity planning, product release management), cloud technical support, cloud escalation management, or cloud consulting.
* Ability to communicate in Mandarin and English fluently to support the client relationship management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* MBA or Master’s degree in a Management, Technical, or Engineering field.
* Experience translating business requirements into technological solutions.
* Experience in application or workload migration to public cloud providers.
* Experience collaborating with teams, groups, business units, channel partners, systems integrators, and third\-party developers to deliver high\-impact solutions.
* Understanding of IT operations, database systems, networking, IT security, application development, service architecture, cloud\-native application development, hosted services, storage systems, or content delivery networks.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, problem\-solving, and client management skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will help customers successfully adopt Google Cloud products. You will lead the successful adoption of Google Cloud at organizations, guiding them through the strategic and technical facets of their Google Cloud transformation journey. You will manage the successful delivery of Cloud Consulting engagements to drive customer adoption of Google Cloud services. In this role, you will regularly engage with various stakeholder groups, including leadership of enterprises and a cross\-functional and geographically dispersed team.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $140000 \- $204000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Accelerate customer adoption of Google Cloud by leading the implementation journey. Provide technical guidance and manage timelines, milestones, migration goal and business transformation strategies.
* Advocate for customer needs in order to overcome adoption blockers and drive new feature development. Lead across multiple work streams and teams to maintain customer momentum.
* Develop relationships with stakeholders to understand customer’s business, develop strategic roadmaps, and lead quarterly business reviews and executive sessions to better understand business and technical needs.

As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will help customers successfully adopt Google Cloud products. jobs.title: Global Account Manager, Developer Relations - Hitachi
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, we are tapping into the boundless possibilities of AI to develop the next era of computing. In this era, GPUs, accelerated software, and AI factories become the brains of computers, robots, industrial systems, and autonomous machines.


As a Global Account Manager, Developer Relations, you will lead the technical efforts to advance integration of NVIDIA's libraries, models, and frameworks. This work will focus on Hitachi, one of our largest and most strategic industrial partners. You will partner with product teams at NVIDIA and Hitachi to encourage NVIDIA software integration into Hitachi platforms and solutions. This supports their long\-term business and technical goals. This highly visible position aligns with our product organization to deliver joint solutions that move the needle and with our enterprise go\-to\-market organization to drive mutual success. The ideal candidate brings an outstanding blend of industrial ecosystem fluency, developer advocacy, and strong technical account management experience across energy, mobility, manufacturing, digital engineering, and enterprise AI.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Drive adoption of NVIDIA software libraries, open models, SDKs, NIMs, blueprints, and frameworks across Hitachi business, product, and engineering groups.
* Partner with NVIDIA account, technical, product, and engineering teams to align integration priorities across multiple Hitachi businesses.
* Accelerate critical Hitachi workloads by incorporating the NVIDIA software stack into products, platforms, and pipelines.
* Connect NVIDIA DevTech, Solution Architecture, Developer Relations, and Product Engineering teams with Hitachi stakeholders to advance collaborative development and adoption.
* Engage executive and technical leaders across NVIDIA and Hitachi to guide integrations, resolve technical challenges, track adoption, identify new workflows, and relay field insights.
* Identify differentiated solution opportunities in Physical AI, DSX / AI Factory, Agentic AI, digital twins, edge AI, and industrial automation while fostering Hitachi needs inside NVIDIA.
* Lead multi\-functional partnership execution across product, engineering, solution architecture, GTM, marketing, ecosystem, and co\-sell teams to deliver early wins, lighthouse successes, and long\-term partnership impact.

**What we need to see:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a similar field, or equivalent experience.
* 12\+ years of overall professional experience in the technology industry in developer relations, product management, technical partnerships, business development, or solutions architecture.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience applying accelerated computing or AI to production workloads, including industrial AI, simulation, computer vision, edge AI, inference, agentic software, data processing, or digital twins.
* Deep understanding of industrial platform ecosystems and the software stack that runs them, including energy infrastructure, rail and mobility, manufacturing, industrial automation, digital engineering, enterprise AI, or IT services.
* Proven ability to structure and implement complex technical engagements, negotiate requirements, prioritize issues, and collaborate with internal and external partners across sales, legal, product, and marketing teams.
* Exceptional ability to distill complex technical concepts and articulate value propositions to audiences ranging from developers to C\-suite executives.
* Experience influencing partner product roadmaps and bringing joint solutions to market with strategic customers or ISV partners.

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Advanced degree such as an MBA, MS, or PhD or equivalent experience in computing, electrical engineering, or a related field.
* Hands\-on experience with NVIDIA software libraries, frameworks, and models, including CUDA\-X, cuDSS, NIM, NeMo / Nemotron, Cosmos, Omniverse, Isaac Sim, Metropolis, DeepStream, PhysicsNeMo, Holoscan, Jetson, or IGX.
* Deep experience working at or alongside Hitachi, or any major industrial technology partners, developer communities, or technical enablement programs.
* Ability to translate developer sentiment, product requirements, and market shifts into actionable intelligence for industry strategy and product roadmap decisions.
* Domain experience in energy systems, grid modernization, AI factories, autonomous mobility, industrial digital twins, or operational technology / IT convergence.


With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to outstanding growth, our best\-in\-class teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous person with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you!


Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 224,000 USD \- 356,500 USD.
You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.


Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 7, 2026\.
This posting is for an existing vacancy.


NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.


NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:

**Req number:** JR16128
  

**Job Type:** Regular Full Time
  

**Pay Range:**


75000\.00 to 90000\.00

  

**Description**


**The Best Teams are Created and Maintained Here.**


**Job** **Summary**


* The Account Manager serves as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of landscape maintenance clients, building long\-term relationships that promote client satisfaction, retention, and ancillary sales. This role is responsible for overseeing field operations.

**Duties and** **Responsibilities:**


* Identify and pursue opportunities to sell ancillary (enhancement) services to existing clients within the portfolio
* Develop accurate estimates and takeoffs for both new and existing clients as needed
* Deliver timely bid proposals and designs for enhancement projects.
* Generate referrals from existing client base and communicate leads to Business Developer
* Build and maintain strong long\-term relations with clients, focusing on all pertinent points of contact
* Conduct regular site walkthroughs with clients to ensure quality and service expectations are met
* Lead and facilitate the resolution of client concerns or issues (land and/or snow)
* Ensure timely account renewals within the assigned client portfolio
* Proactively assess and address site enhancement needs during visits
* Collaborate with the Operations Manager to ensure service delivery meets or exceeds expectations (land and/or snow)
* Schedule regular site visits with the Operations Manager for quality reviews and to ensure client expectations are met (land and/or snow)
* Support hiring, training, and coaching of field crews for the assigned portfolio
* Promote and enforce safety policies and procedures
* Ensure branch financial goals are met by maintaining acceptable gross margins for both base contract work and ancillary (enhancement) services
* Assist the Branch Manager in overall leadership of the branch to include participation in all relevant meetings
* Maintain proper account documentation and notes in the CRM system
* Monitor and maintain satisfactory accounts receivable levels (land and/or snow)
* Coordinate with the Branch Administrator to keep client records and contact information current
* Perform additional duties as assigned by the Branch Manager

**Education and** **Experience:**


* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in a business\-related field, or equivalent experience in a customer\-focused service industry
* inimum 3 years of experience in customer service, management, and leadership, preferably in the landscaping industry or local marketplace.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated leadership and coaching abilities
* Ability to foster collaboration and teamwork

**Physical** **Demands/Requirements:**


* Operation of a computer and other office equipment/system, such as a laptop, cell phone, and sales and operational programs/tools
* Position is a combination of mobile and sedentary work; must be able to remain in a stationary position for long periods of time
* Customarily and regularly spends more than half of the time working away from BrightView’s places of business, walking job sites, selling and obtaining orders or contracts for BrightView’s services
* Ability to travel by car, train, and plane
* Position needs to be able to traverse uneven grounds and walk on job sites with clients and the branch team for periods of time up to 4 hours
* Ability to maintain, in your possession at all times, required medications to address any known allergic reactions should they occur

**Work** **Environment:**


* Works both indoors and outdoors; attends branch stretch and flex 3\-4 days per week
* Field\-based position, a combination of office and customer\-facing

*BrightView Landscapes, LLC is an Equal Opportunity and E\-Verify Employer.*

*This job description is subject to change at any time*


**Compensation Pay Range:**


75000\.00 to 90000\.00

Benefits offerings for full\-time team members include medical, dental, and vision insurance, ancillary and voluntary products, a 401k savings plan with employer contributions, and 6 to 9 company paid holidays per year. Employees may also be eligible to receive paid time off for vacation and/or sick leave, tuition reimbursement, and/or potential variable pay opportunities based on position and performance. A detailed benefits package will be provided during the interview process****.*

jobs.title: Therapeutic Account Manager, Liver - Palo Alto
jobs.description:
**MISSION**



Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we're looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

**POSITION SUMMARY**



The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high\-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.



The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight\-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross\-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow\-through.


**JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Territory Strategy \& Business Performance**


* Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
* Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
* Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high\-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
* Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.


**Strategic Account Management \& Network Development**


* Identify, prioritize, and develop high\-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
* Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision\-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
* Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow\-through.
* Map influence and decision\-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
* Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.


**Clinical Aptitude \& Customer Engagement**


* Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
* Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
* Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
* Execute approved promotional programs, resources, and customer engagements with consistency, clinical relevance, sound judgment, and full adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.


**Influence \& Impact**


* Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.
* Use high emotional intelligence, curiosity, credibility, and thoughtful questioning to build trust with skeptical, change\-resistant, or highly experienced healthcare professionals.
* Influence multiple stakeholders without authority, navigate resistance constructively, and balance persistence with judgment, empathy, and respect for customer boundaries


**Customer, Patient \& Caregiver Impact**


* Keep patients and caregivers at the center of territory and account decisions, with a clear understanding of the journey from disease recognition and diagnosis through treatment initiation and persistence.
* Support a customer experience grounded in trust, empathy, responsiveness, urgency, and reliable follow\-through with healthcare professionals and care teams.

jobs.title: Global Account Manager, Healthcare and Life Sciences, Health Care and Life Sciences, Field - AWS Industries - HCLS - AWSI
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) Industry team to execute on the industry strategy by working backwards and in collaboration with the world’s most innovative companies. Our team focuses on engaging directly with technical leaders, C\-level executives and influencers at all levels across the Life Sciences segment and around the world to support a digitally\-enhanced, data\-driven healthcare.  

  

As a Global Account Manager Manager, you will grow the AWS footprint. This role will build and maintain relationships, advise customers on AWS cloud solutions, grow AWS usage across a defined set of customers, develop innovative programs, and expand platform adoption to new business units. You will work with prospects, customers, partners, and internal teams to consistently meet and exceed sales quotas. This is a strategic role with tremendous growth opportunities.  

  

You will be responsible for building relationships with key IT and business unit executives and other stakeholders within a large Life Science customer, with the aim of generating demand for the AWS services through both AWS\-led solutions and AWS Partner solutions.  

  

You will build and maintain relationships, lead/support sales pursuits to advise our customers on AWS cloud solutions, grow AWS usage, develop innovative programs, and expand platform adoption to new business units.  

  

As a HCLS Global Account Manager, you will be part of the HCLS Industry team that shapes and delivers on a global healthcare strategy to help the healthcare ecosystem transform. Your responsibilities will include engaging with C\-suite customers across Life Sciences organizations to deepen our relationships, working with strategic industry partners, attending and speaking at industry events to drive thought leadership, leading the process to guide our Go\-to\-Market (GTM) strategy, and creating significant business opportunities for AWS. You will work closely with the AWS sales leadership in engaging with healthcare organizations to drive their strategic interactions with clients. You will work closely with the AWS product and services teams to help evolve AWS offerings for more rapid adoption by customers.  

  

You will work with Life Sciences Organizations as a primary revenue generating business and interact at the executive level (CxO/VP). You will think strategically and analytically about business, product, and technical challenges and build and convey compelling value propositions, and work cross\-organizationally to build consensus. You will lead and drive multiple complex initiatives across technical and non\-technical stakeholders to meet business objectives with a customer\-obsessed and collaborative approach, strong data and metrics, a good understanding of industry ecosystems for life sciences, and a passion for helping them transform using cloud technologies.

jobs.description:
NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing to take on problems ordinary computers cannot! We innovate at the intersection of computer graphics, high performance computing, and artificial intelligence. Accelerated computing is reshaping trillion\-dollar industries like transportation, healthcare, and manufacturing, and fostering entirely new industries just taking root. We're building a company, one that makes unique and contributions to the world. We want to attract the world's best people in our field, give them a place to do their life's work, where they can build a great life, and promise never to squander their talents. Our company is designed to evolve quickly to address new opportunities, making clear, timely internal and external communication of our business strategy a top priority.


Our Executive Communications team partners closely with NVIDIA’s CEO and senior leaders to shape how the company shows up across social platforms, stages, screens, meetings, and media. We are looking for an exceptional writer and social media strategist to lead the day\-to\-day social presence of NVIDIA’s executives. You will help inform editorial strategy, spotting timely opportunities to drafting, refining, and publishing distinctive content in an authentic executive voice. The remaining focus will be on select internal and external communications, including projects like annual report, CSR letter, and Stockholder Day.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Lead the editorial strategy, planning and day\-to\-day execution of social media for highly visible executives.

* Partner with creative and cross\-functional teams to develop social\-first storytelling across text, images, and video, and use performance insights to continually improve content and audience engagement.

Are you an experienced Sales Professional, Restaurant Manager, Culinary Manager or Chef looking for career development opportunities? Join Sysco’s World Class Sales Team and explore all the benefits and perks.

* Competitive base salary, bonus, plus promotional incentive opportunities
* Car allowance (mileage reimbursement for candidates in CA) and cell phone provided
* Career pathing opportunities for both entry level, and experienced individuals
* Opportunity to be part of a purpose driven organization that supports communities and associates
* Specialized sales training
* Individual as well as team\-based selling
* Opportunity to learn different ethnic segments
* Monthly and annual sales rewards and recognition
* Robust benefits package including an Employee Stock Purchase Plan, \& 401(k) with automatic matching

**JOB SUMMARY**  

This is an outside sales position responsible for promoting the company's products and services and for building relationships with new and existing accounts. The main focus is to help Sysco customers succeed while achieving sales and profit goals established by the company. This position may require working some non\-traditional hours (evening, weekends, and holidays) to successfully meet customers' needs.  

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop new business, penetrate existing accounts, and minimize lost business to achieve profitable sales growth and special objectives within assigned territory.
* Seek and qualify prospects following company account stratification goals.

* Evaluate market trends and recommend products to customers, based on business needs and goals.

* Ability to read, write, speak English.

* Building Trust
* Building Customer Loyalty
* Follow\-up

* Managing Work
* Adaptability
* Communication

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
jobs.description:
**About Sirona Medical**
------------------------



At **Sirona Medical**, we're building software that enables physicians to work as fast as they can think.



Each year in the U.S., **billions of patient images** are captured—and nearly all of them are reviewed and diagnosed by radiologists. These specialists are the central hub of diagnostic medicine: **over 80% of all healthcare data flows through radiology IT systems**. Yet despite their pivotal role, radiologists are overburdened by outdated, fragmented software which limits their efficiency and ultimately the quality and efficiency of care that health systems can provide patients. That's where Sirona comes in.



We're a **San Francisco\-based, cloud\-native software company** with employees around the world. Our deep understanding of both the **practice and business of radiology** has allowed us to build **RadOS**—a unified, AI\-powered operating system powering the entire radiology workflows.


### **How Sirona Solves the Problem**



Sirona is **uniquely positioned to transform the way radiology is practiced**. We're delivering the organizational shift that both individual radiologists and entire practices urgently need:


* A **unified**, intuitive, and **platform\-agnostic** solution
* A streamlined workspace that makes **every part of the radiologist's workflow faster and easier**
* The freedom to **read from anywhere, for anyone**

By cutting clicks, optimizing diagnostic time, and unlocking efficiencies that extend **far beyond the reading room into all care settings**, Sirona empowers radiologists—and in doing so, we help the entire healthcare system move faster, smarter, and with greater impact on patient outcomes.

For more information, please visit https://sironamedical.com/join/.
As a Sales Development Representative, you will be pivotal in driving Sirona Medical's growth by identifying and engaging potential new clients, showcasing how our innovative radiology solutions can transform their operations. You are the initial point of contact, tasked with sparking interest and paving the way for in\-depth sales discussions.



As we build and refine our Go\-To\-Market (GTM) motion, this role offers significant opportunity for growth and career development. You'll play a pivotal part in shaping how we engage the market, collaborate cross\-functionally, and scale our impact — with a clear path to take on more strategic responsibility as we grow.



This is a remote position from within the United States.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Lead Generation: Use targeted strategies to identify potential clients in the healthcare sector, focusing on how our integrated radiology systems can meet their needs.
* Qualification of Leads: Assess the potential of leads to benefit from our unified platform, including our advanced viewer and AI\-enhanced diagnostic tools.
* Appointment Setting: Arrange detailed discussions between prospects and sales executives, emphasizing the benefits and efficiencies our solutions offer.
* CRM Management: Keep meticulous records of interactions and statuses in our CRM system, ensuring all team members have up\-to\-date information.
* Market Research: Keep abreast of technological advancements and competitive developments in radiology to refine and enhance sales pitches.
* Collaboration: Collaborate with the sales and marketing teams to refine approaches based on market feedback and new product capabilities.
* Performance Metrics: Consistently meet or exceed monthly targets for qualified leads and arranged meetings.


**Key Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a relevant field.
* 1\-2 years experience in sales development or lead generation, ideally within healthcare technology.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficient with CRM systems, such as Salesforce or Hubspot.
* Resilient in handling rejections and motivated by challenges.
* Strong organizational and time management abilities.
* Energetic, results\-driven, and committed to ongoing learning and professional development.


**Benefits:**


* Generous Compensation Plan with Uncapped upside potential
* Stock Options
* Unlimited PTO
* Medical, dental, vision insurance
* Life insurance
* Maternity and Paternity Leave
* 401K matching
* Apple equipment
* Sponsorship for conferences, continuing education, etc.


The annual US base salary for this full\-time position is $75,000 \+ 20% commission \+ additional 1% pool of total contracted ARR through the balance of this fiscal year \+ equity \+ benefits. Pay scale is flexible depending on experience. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, competencies, experience, relevant education and training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**ABOUT SPHERE**
----------------


Every breakthrough in trade infrastructure has followed the same pattern: reduce a transaction cost, expand the market. Containerization for goods. SWIFT for money. Stripe for payments. Compliance is one of the last and largest — and the hardest, because trade rules aren't data to be looked up. They're a complex adaptive system with 190\+ sovereign jurisdictions, in different languages, changing constantly, reacting to each other.


Sphere built the system that solves it. Our AI (TRAM) ingests global trade law, interprets it, resolves conflicts across jurisdictions, and produces compliance determinations more reliable than human experts. We handle the entire lifecycle — calculation, registration, filing, remittance — at millisecond latency with zero downtime.

* **Backed by a16z and YC.** $21M Series A, 30%\+ month\-over\-month growth, customers include ElevenLabs, Replit, Deel, Runway, and Lovable.
* **Small team, global surface area**. Everyone owns a domain that would be a full team at a larger company. San Francisco, five days in office.
* **The problem keeps compounding.** Expanding into input tax, withholding, e\-invoicing, tariffs — each multiplies the complexity. Tens of millions of transactions today, billions ahead.

  

**THE ROLE**
------------


Sphere is looking for a Sales Development Representative to help build our outbound sales engine.


You'll work directly with our Account Executives and Founder to identify the companies we should be selling to, understand why Sphere matters to them, and create opportunities with CFOs, Controllers, Tax leaders, and other senior finance executives.


This isn't a role where you'll inherit a finished playbook and spend your day running someone else's sequences. You'll be expected to prospect relentlessly, learn quickly, experiment with what works, and help us build the playbook as we go.

**This role is designed to be a path into an Account Executive position at Sphere.** You'll get exposure to the full sales cycle from day one, learn directly from our AEs and the founder, and take on more responsibility as you prove you're ready. We want to develop our next generation of AEs from within.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

* Build and own targeted account lists across our core markets.
* Prospect into CFOs, Controllers, Heads of Tax, and other senior finance leaders.
* Research companies to understand their business model, global footprint, and why Sphere could matter to them.
* Create pipeline through phone, email, LinkedIn, events, and creative outbound.
* Work directly with AEs on account strategy, messaging, and multithreading.
* Learn how to qualify real business problems rather than simply book meetings.
* Get exposure to discovery, demos, deal strategy, negotiation, and closing.
* Take on increasing ownership of opportunities as you develop.
* Experiment constantly with messaging, targeting, signals, and new ways to create pipeline.
* Help build the outbound playbook that future SDRs at Sphere will inherit.

  

**REQUIREMENTS**
----------------

* You want to build a career in B2B sales and eventually own a number.
* You're a strong communicator and comfortable starting conversations with people more senior than you.
* You're competitive, curious, and willing to put in the reps.
* You learn quickly and actively seek feedback.
* You're comfortable operating in an environment where the answer isn't always obvious.
* You take ownership instead of waiting to be told what to do.
* You're excited to work alongside the team in our San Francisco office five days a week.

  

**NICE TO HAVES**
-----------------

* Previous SDR experience is helpful, but not required. We're more interested in trajectory than pedigree.
* Previous outbound sales or prospecting experience.
* Experience at an early stage startup.
* Experience selling or working with Finance, Accounting, or Tax teams.
* Evidence that you've been exceptional at something competitive, whether that's sales, athletics, academics, entrepreneurship, or something else.

  

**WHO YOU ARE**
---------------

*You'll thrive here if:*

* **You're a Dog.** You've been underestimated, gone through struggle, and never stopped running. You have a chip on your shoulder and enormous drive. You look at Stripe, Deel, and Flexport all punting on compliance and think: *good, that means the opportunity is ours.* Hunger beats pedigree.
* **Early stage is in your bones.** You've built things where there's no playbook and nobody handing you the answer. You define the problem instead of waiting for instructions.
* **You own it end to end.** Give you a goal and you figure out your own path. Small team, global surface area — everyone owns a domain that would be a full team at a larger company. No one tells you how.
* **You believe speed and accuracy are both possible.** We're building a complex product that requires robustness and 100% uptime, and we have to build at our customers' pace. Move fast. Don't break things. Both.
* **Being in the room is a feature, not a cost.** Five days in SF isn't a policy, it's how the work gets done. The speed and density of collaboration we need doesn't survive over video.

 *This won't be a fit if:*

* You need structure handed to you or ambiguity feels draining rather than motivating
* You want to manage people more than own hard problems (we're a flat, experienced team — everyone builds)
* You're used to "good enough" shipping (small errors have outsized impact here)
* Being in the room five days a week feels like a cost instead of a benefit


Compensation Range: $75K \- $140K

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About XLI**
At XLI, we build more than just structures. We build careers, relationships, and the future. As a purpose\-driven general contractor, our culture is grounded in servant leadership, accountability, and collaboration. Our Assistant Project Managers are integral to driving success across our projects and shaping the future of construction.  

**Position Summary**
The Assistant Project Manager (APM) plays a critical role in supporting the successful planning and execution of construction projects. In partnership with the Project Manager and Superintendent, the APM oversees documentation, procurement, budgeting, schedule adherence, and quality control. This role is ideal for a dynamic builder with strong attention to detail, leadership capabilities, and a passion for continuous learning.  

**Key Responsibilities*** Review contracts, assess risk, and communicate key areas of exposure to the project team.
* Lead the bid process by developing detailed instructions to bidders, ensuring scope coverage, accuracy, and appropriate risk mitigation.
* Support subcontractor buyout and selection processes, including subcontract execution and issue resolution.
* Assemble and manage the project control estimate.
* Manage all aspects of construction management, including:
* Preconstruction
* Scheduling
* Procurement
* Submittals
* RFIs
* Change orders
* Budgeting
* Forecasting
* Billing
* Project closeout
* Ensure project permits, inspections, and tests are accurately identified and scheduled.
* Own the project procurement plan and procurement log, proactively identifying and mitigating risks.
* Foster effective relationships with clients and design teams through consistent communication and leadership during Owner/Architect/Contractor (OAC) meetings and site walks.
* Maintain document control accuracy and timeliness.
* Leverage internal resources including VDC, Lean practices, SPW, XL Shop, and other tools to drive project and team effectiveness.
* Train and mentor Project Engineers, Project Administrators, and Project Accountants.
* Promote and model XLI's core values, safety culture, and operational excellence.

 **Required Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of construction experience, preferably as a Senior Project Engineer or Assistant Project Manager.
* Experience working on healthcare, education, life sciences, civic, or commercial office projects.
* Demonstrated experience managing or assisting with small projects.
* Proficiency with:
* Microsoft Office
* Procore
* Primavera P6
* Timberline
* Vista
* Solid understanding of:
* MEP trades
* Scheduling
* Permit processes
* OSHA 10 Certification.
* Ability to build trust across project stakeholders and internal teams.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.

 **Core Competencies*** XLI Stewardship
* Managerial Courage
* Bridge Builder
* People Developer
* Continuous Learner
* Business Acumen
* Strategic Edge

 **Compensation**
In accordance with California's Pay Transparency Laws (SB 1162\), XLI is committed to fair and equitable compensation.* Base Salary Range: $120,000 – $135,000 annually
* Eligible for annual performance bonus program
* Eligible for vehicle reimbursement


Compensation will be determined based on experience, education, qualifications, and internal equity.  

**Why Join XLI?**
At XLI, we offer more than a job. We offer a purpose. From career development to mentorship and a people\-first culture, we are proud to support your growth in construction leadership.  

**Benefits Include*** Competitive salary and annual bonus program
* Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, and vision
* 401(k) with company match
* Generous paid time off and company holidays
* Monthly vehicle reimbursement
* Monthly cell phone reimbursement
* Opportunities to work on meaningful, high\-impact projects

jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

Job Title: Order and Production Coordinator  
Company: Indigo Promotions  
Location: North Bergen, NJ, In Person  
Job Type: Full Time  
Experience Level: Entry Level  
Compensation: $18\.00 to $20\.00 per hour

About Indigo Promotions:

Indigo Promotions is a minority\-owned branded merchandise company that creates custom products, apparel, packaging, event giveaways, and corporate gifting programs for leading global brands. We manage creative, deadline\-driven projects through domestic suppliers, overseas factories, and our in\-house production capabilities.

Position Overview:

Indigo Promotions is seeking an organized, dependable, and highly detail\-oriented Order and Production Coordinator to join our team.

This is an entry\-level position with hands\-on training provided. You will learn how to create purchase orders, communicate with suppliers and factories, monitor production schedules, review order details, and help ensure projects are completed accurately and delivered on time.

The goal is for this person to gradually take ownership of the production coordination process for an assigned group of clients. No promotional products experience is required, but you must be organized, comfortable following detailed processes, and willing to take responsibility for keeping projects on track.

Responsibilities:

* Create purchase orders with accurate pricing, quantities, product specifications, artwork instructions, shipping information, and delivery dates.
* Communicate regularly with domestic suppliers and overseas factories to request updates and keep orders moving.
* Monitor production schedules and confirm that projects remain on track for their required delivery dates.
* Request and organize virtual proofs, product samples, production photos, tracking information, and shipping documents.
* Carefully review purchase orders, proofs, and production details for accuracy before orders move forward.
* Track projects from the time an order is placed through production, shipping, and final delivery.
* Keep CommonSku and internal project trackers updated with accurate order information.
* Notify the team immediately about potential delays, inventory problems, artwork concerns, or production issues.
* Help coordinate solutions when an order encounters a production or shipping problem.
* Maintain clear records of factory conversations, approvals, deadlines, and project updates.
* Learn Indigo Promotions’ production procedures and gradually take ownership of assigned orders and client projects.
* Assist with estimates, sales orders, invoices, and client presentations when needed.
* Handle additional production and operational responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications and Skills:

* This is an entry\-level position, and previous promotional products or production experience is not required.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to review information carefully.
* Excellent organization and time\-management skills.
* Clear and professional written communication.
* Ability to follow established procedures while learning when to ask questions or escalate an issue.
* Comfortable managing several assignments and deadlines at the same time.
* Dependable, responsive, and willing to follow through until a task is completed.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where priorities may change.
* Basic proficiency with Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Sheets, and Google Docs.
* Willingness to learn CommonSku and other order\-management tools.
* Experience in customer service, administration, purchasing, logistics, project coordination, or order processing is helpful but not required.
* Experience communicating with vendors or working across international time zones is a plus.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn from feedback.

Training and Growth:

The Order and Production Coordinator will receive hands\-on training in Indigo Promotions’ systems, supplier relationships, order\-management procedures, and production processes.

The successful candidate will begin by supporting existing production workflows and learning alongside an experienced team member. As their knowledge and confidence grow, they will be expected to independently manage purchase orders, supplier communication, production schedules, and delivery tracking for assigned projects.

Schedule Expectations:

This is a full\-time, in\-person position. Because Indigo Promotions works with overseas factories and manages time\-sensitive projects, occasional communication outside standard business hours may be required. This is not a 24\-hour on\-call position, but flexibility may be needed when an urgent production matter arises.

Additional Information:

Indigo Promotions is an equal opportunity employer offering competitive compensation, hands\-on training, and opportunities for professional growth.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone beginning their career who wants to develop practical experience in production, purchasing, operations, logistics, and branded merchandise.

To apply, please submit your resume directly to ethan@indigopromos.com.

Pay: $18\.00 \- $20\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Under the supervision of the Principal, the Community Coordinator will perform duties related to developing and improving community relations. **Front Desk \& Administrative Coordinator**

**20–40 Hours per Week \| Upper East Side, Manhattan**

We are seeking an **energetic, socially engaging and proactive Front Desk \& Administrative Coordinator** to support two partner companies, **Active Studios and Self Empowered Minds**, located just around the corner from one another on Manhattan’s Upper East Side.

This is much more than sitting behind a front desk. We’re looking for someone who genuinely enjoys people, brings positive energy into a space, takes initiative, works well as part of a team, and is comfortable helping promote our classes, services, workshops and trainings.

You’ll move between our two nearby locations as needed, helping create a welcoming experience while supporting the administrative, promotional and day\-to\-day needs of both businesses.

What You’ll Do

**Front Desk \& Client/Student Experience**

* Warmly greet students and clients and make them feel welcome
* Check students into classes and maintain accurate attendance
* Answer calls, emails and inquiries
* Assist with scheduling, registrations and appointments
* Maintain welcoming, organized and beautifully presented spaces
* Assist with light cleaning and resetting the spaces as needed
* Help with workshops, trainings and special events

**Administrative Support**

* Handle day\-to\-day administrative tasks
* Maintain organized student/client and scheduling information
* Learn and work with our scheduling and business systems
* Help ensure daily operations run smoothly
* Work collaboratively with instructors, practitioners and other team members

**Promotion, Outreach \& Social Media**

* Follow up with people who have expressed interest in our classes, services, workshops and trainings
* Help turn inquiries into registrations and appointments through warm, personable follow\-up
* Engage with students and clients and make them aware of other services, classes and events they may enjoy
* Actively help promote upcoming programs, workshops and special events
* Create and post social media content
* Take simple photos and videos when appropriate
* Create basic graphics and promotional content; Canva experience is a plus
* Help keep our social media presence active, current and engaging

Who We’re Looking For

We’re especially interested in someone who is:

* **Extremely punctual and dependable** — our students, clients and team rely on the front desk being ready on time
* **Energetic and socially engaging** — someone who genuinely enjoys talking with and getting to know people
* **Proactive** — someone who sees what needs to be done and takes initiative
* **A team player** — willing to jump in and help wherever needed
* Warm, personable and naturally welcoming
* Comfortable promoting services and making recommendations without being pushy
* Organized and able to manage multiple responsibilities
* Professional and discreet
* **Comfortable working in a Mac/Apple environment, including Mac laptops, iPhones and iPads**
* Comfortable learning and working with scheduling systems and other technology
* Comfortable creating and posting social media content
* Able to work independently without needing constant direction
* Interested in wellness, fitness, movement and/or personal development

Schedule \& Position Structure

**20–40 hours per week**

The exact schedule will depend on availability and experience. Some evening and weekend availability is important because our classes, workshops and trainings take place throughout the week.

This position will initially be structured as a **1099 independent contractor position**, with the potential to transition to a W\-2 employee position in the future. As a 1099 independent contractor, you are responsible for your own tax withholding and tax obligations.

About the Position

This position supports **Active Studios and Self Empowered Minds, two partner companies located just around the corner from one another on the Upper East Side.**

The environment and responsibilities vary throughout the day. You might be greeting students arriving for a class, helping someone register for a workshop, following up with an inquiry, creating a social media post, preparing for an event, completing administrative work, or welcoming a private wellness client.

We are looking for someone who enjoys variety, likes interacting with people and wants to become an active part of a small, growing team.

Please submit your résumé along with a brief introduction telling us:
