jobs.title: Junior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Hey there!
  

We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.



Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting\-edge technology and data\-driven approach, we're revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
  

  

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in \+55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.



Our results? We've teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award\-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?



To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar\-raisers with a hands\-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!  

  

Ready to be part of the experience?



Now, let's discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever's mission.


As part of the Fever Originals team, you will use data and insights to create one\-of\-a\-kind events and experiences that allow people to have unforgettable moments.


**Who you'll work with**  

  

You will join one of our offices around the world to work in teams and directly interact with our partners, providers, and venues.  

  

In this role you will help Fever grow its pipeline of original events. To do so, you will interact with all departments of Fever, from Marketing to Operations.  

  

The team you're about to join consists of people that are motivated, young, and fun. On top of having multicultural backgrounds, people in the team are all top profiles: McKinsey, Amazon, Google, KKR, Cirque du Soleil, PSG, and Roland Garros.



Employees are expected to be in the office Monday to Thursday with possibility to work from home on Fridays.  

  

**What you'll do**  

  

**As a Project Manager, you will work with your team lead to develop, launch and manage your events, from A to Z. Together with the other departments, you will define the way to scale this event to all our other markets.**  

**You will be responsible for owning the strategic planning, execution, and reporting for our key strategic scalable experiences.**

  


When you join Fever, you are joining a company that will invest in your professional development. You will receive training and coaching on how to:


* **Provide a detailed analysis of business opportunities and inefficiencies; proposing changes to operational processes; driving a high standard in customer satisfaction; ensuring high\-quality experiences are delivered.**
* Work with the Fever marketing team to make sure events make an impact: both in terms of ticket sales and coverage
* Manage, report on, and grow revenue from scalable events
* Grow the scalable experiences against team targets
* Help to scale the events to our other cities through developing and sharing best practices (opportunity for travel)
* Foster and grow the Fever Partner Network: including venues and event organizers
* Communicate product needs (Fever usability) and process needs to HQ, work with product/engineering to deliver on themRepresent Fever at local events and with local PR
  


**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* 1\+ years in a project management role or consulting background. This is not a position for an events background.
* Fluent English.
* Huge appetite for learning and the ability to pick up new skills quickly. You will also have strong analytical, relationship management, and organizational skills.
* You'll be solution\-focused, identifying problem areas and then creating plans to find resolutions.
* You'll have strong communication skills and a proven track record of building positive working relationships.
* Highly organized and efficient
* Curious and keen to push boundaries and try new concepts
* Great networking skills and the ability to make smart partnerships happen
* Able to communicate with events partners, brands, agencies, and talent on efforts
* Ability to think strategically when faced with an events partnership brief or with our proprietary data on what events work
* Able to handle large amounts of work and parallel work\-streams
* Collaborative and willing to get hands dirty and work on all required events tasks
* Knowledge of promotional tools such as Facebook and Instagram is a plus
* Strong academic background is a plus


You can expect to join a group of diverse, hardworking team players, where a cultural fit is someone willing to stay humble and learn and can work nimbly. We welcome applications with unusual backgrounds with the expectation that the applicant will have acquired hard or soft skills and maturity throughout their experiences.

  

**What you'll get**


* Opportunity to have a real impact in a high\-growth global category leader
* Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance (total compensation of around 70\-75k)
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Gympass Memberships
* 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
* Work in a location in the heart of Manhattan
* Responsibility from day one with strong opportunities for professional growth
* Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!


**Our hiring process**


* A 30 min video call with one of our Talent Acquisition Managers, to better understand your career plan, assess cultural fit and answer any questions you may have
* A 60 min online test with three topics: logic, analytics and written understanding
* A 30 min interview with your future manager
* A 45 min video call with your future manager, including questions about your profile and a business case presentation (to be prepared in advance)


On average our process lasts 20 working days and offers usually follow within

jobs.title: Arterial Account Manager - New York Metro - Peripheral Vascular
jobs.description:
### **Why join Stryker?**


Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award\-winning culture.  

We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.### **Job description**


We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine! We are proud to offer you 12 paid holidays annually. For an overview of our benefits and time off, please follow this link to learn more:US Stryker employee benefits.
Are you a strategic, clinically savvy sales professional passionate about driving meaningful impact in vascular care? Join us as an **Arterial Account Manager**, where you’ll operate with autonomy, lead program development, and partner with top physicians and health system leaders to bring life‑changing PAD and CLTI therapies to more patients.


In this high‑visibility role, you’ll collaborate across specialties—including interventionalists, vascular surgeons, service line leadership, and internal cross‑functional teams—to develop, launch, and scale PAD and LimFlow programs. You will also work closely with local Account Managers and Field Clinical Specialists to accelerate adoption and drive growth.

**What You’ll Do**

* Identify new growth opportunities and uncover unmet clinical needs within PAD and CLTI patient populations.
* Build alignment with multidisciplinary stakeholders, including physician champions and hospital leadership.
* Drive therapy adoption through clinical expertise, education, and program‑building initiatives.
* Create demand and expand access to the Artix and LimFlow portfolios to grow long‑term franchise value.
* Execute coordinated strategies with VTE Account Managers using shared targets, aligned messaging, and real\-time field insights.
* Deliver high‑impact presentations outlining clinical and financial benefits of the portfolio to physicians and hospital administration.
* Provide valuable product feedback to R\&D and Marketing, serving as a key clinical voice for innovation.
* Represent the company at trade shows, conferences, and educational events.
* Act as a clinical subject matter expert during national calls and training programs.
* Partner with Sales Leadership and Medical Education to support new hire onboarding and ongoing training needs.
* Develop and disseminate insights to internal stakeholders during pre‑sale and evaluation processes.
* Perform other responsibilities as needed to support regional and national initiatives.

**What You Bring**

**Skills \& Abilities**

* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Strong MS Office skills (PowerPoint, Excel, reporting).
* Exceptional presentation skills—from 1:1 settings to large audiences.
* Clinical excellence and comfort in case‑based environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Proven leadership and the ability to educate and develop others.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.
* Passion for delivering patient‑focused, team‑based healthcare solutions.
* Robust sales and business acumen.
* Strong communication habits using company systems and tools.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Science degree in a related field.
* Minimum 6 years of medical device field sales experience.
* Current certifications and vendor credentials.
* Demonstrated history of consistent quota attainment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* At least **2 years of experience with Stryker or Inari** sales/clinical (preferred).
* Previous experience in the **peripheral arterial space**.

**Why This Role Matters**


This is a unique opportunity to shape programs, lead strategic initiatives, and be at the forefront of innovation in PAD and CLTI care. If you thrive in clinically oriented environments, love building partnerships, and want to make a lasting impact on patient outcomes — we’d love to talk.

  

Base \+ commission: $125,000\.00 and may be eligible to earn commission and/or bonuses \+ benefits.


Health benefits include: Medical and prescription drug insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, critical illness insurance, accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, personalized healthcare support, wellbeing program and tobacco cessation program. Financial benefits include: Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), 401(k) plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), basic life and AD\&D insurance, and short\-term disability insurance. Stryker offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually. Depending on customer requirements employees and new hires in sales and field roles that require access to customer accounts as a function of the job may be required to obtain various vaccinations as an essential function of their role.

jobs.title: Confirmed Account Manager
jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI\-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000\+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer\-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.


Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post\-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real\-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.


Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world\-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.


At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product\-driven, and execution\-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

  

**How we work at Aircall**: We’re customer\-obsessed, data\-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast\-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

  

As a Confirmed Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.


By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.


This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota\-carrying seller. You’ll partner cross\-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add\-on SKUs, and build deep, long\-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.


Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market\-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.


**This is a hybrid role based in NYC.**


### **Key Responsibilities:**


* Own NRR: Manage the full post\-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.
* Drive Growth: Identify and activate growth opportunities within your portfolio, prospecting into new subsidiaries, use cases, and additional SKUs to unlock untapped potential.
* Target Strategically: Prioritize high\-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long\-term growth plans.
* Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.
* Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi\-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision\-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.
* Sell Competitively: Position Aircall’s value head\-to\-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer’s unique business needs.
* Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty.
* Manage Pipeline \& Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data\-driven NRR forecasting.
* Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
* Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall’s product roadmap and go\-to\-market strategies.
* Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives.
  

### **Qualifications:**


* Experienced in SaaS Account Management, Commercial Customer Success, or Renewal Management, with a track record of achieving revenue targets.
* Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy.
* Customer\-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.
* Capable of developing and executing account expansion strategies, including stakeholder mapping and whitespace analysis.
* Confident in competitive sales cycles, able to articulate differentiation and handle objections effectively.
* Analytical, detail\-oriented, and accountable for forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene.
* Resilient, driven, and passionate about helping customers realize long\-term value through partnership.
* Excited by innovation and transformation — particularly the opportunity to represent a next\-generation AI\-powered communications platform.

jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Handshake**
===================


Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.


In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

**Why join Handshake now:**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast\-growing business with billions in revenue

We're redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.



Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall's AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post\-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real\-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.



Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We've built a product customers love and a business that's scaling quickly, backed by world\-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.



At Aircall, you'll join a company in motion. We're ambitious, product\-driven, and execution\-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

  


**How we work at Aircall**: We're customer\-obsessed, data\-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast\-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you'll feel at home here.

This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.



This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota\-carrying seller. You'll partner cross\-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add\-on SKUs, and build deep, long\-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.



Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market\-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.


**This is a hybrid role based in NYC.**

* Own NRR: Manage the full post\-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager, Product Marketing
jobs.description:
**Why Join GEICO?**


At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

  

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

  

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

**About the Role:**


Within Product Marketing at GEICO, the digital funnel is where marketing investment either converts or doesn't. This role exists to understand exactly why — and to fix it.


The Digital Marketing Manager, Product Marketing analyzes performance across owned digital channels and the online funnel, identifying where conversion is breaking down, diagnosing root causes, and partnering with Engineering on experiment design and testing to drive improvement. A core part of the role is owning the full ad\-to\-application view: connecting how traffic from performance media and organic channels behaves on\-site, understanding the Martech and measurement ecosystem that enables that view, partnering with SEO/AEO on discoverability and on\-site optimization, and working with Creative on landing page optimization. The output is a single, coherent picture of the digital funnel — and a prioritized, cross\-functional agenda for improving it. The role is also hands\-on day to day: making page\-level content and layout edits directly in the CMS in close collaboration with Creative, SEO and Engineering.


This role requires someone with proven, hands\-on experience in digital analytics and conversion optimization — not just familiarity with the tools, but a track record of diagnosing funnel problems, understanding how Martech and measurement systems shape the data, and driving measurable improvement through experimentation and cross\-functional partnership.

**How We Work:**


The Marketing organization at GEICO is guided by a clear set of principles: we hire the best at every level and invest in developing them. We believe that strategy comes before action — if we don't know why we're doing something, we don't do it. We bring the same care and accountability to how we spend resources as we would if it were our own business. And when there are challenges, we face them directly and collectively. Leaders in this organization are expected to bring that same mindset to their teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Funnel \& Experience Analysis**

* Review the online funnel end\-to\-end — from ad click through completed application — to identify gaps, drop\-off points, and conversion opportunities
* Independently analyze site, funnel, and business performance using analytics tools and operational data
* Identify trends, diagnose root causes, and distinguish between experience issues, traffic quality issues, and execution issues
* Communicate the expected impact of marketing investment changes on site metrics, giving stakeholders a clear before/after view

**Marketing Spend \& Traffic Translation**

* Understand traffic composition by marketing channel (paid search, paid social, affiliate, organic) and how each channel's traffic behaves on\-site
* Translate channel\-level spend and traffic characteristics into expected site performance benchmarks by source
* Surface where upstream channel quality and downstream site metrics tell different stories, and propose experience optimizations tied to how different traffic sources actually behave
* Work closely with Marketing Analytics and channel owners to understand campaign optimizations, traffic mix changes, and their downstream impact on funnel performance

**SEO/AEO, Landing Page Optimization \& CMS Execution**

* Partner with SEO/AEO teams to align on\-site content, structure, and technical performance with organic search and answer\-engine discoverability goals
* Analyze landing page performance by traffic source and campaign, identifying where messaging, layout, or performance is limiting conversion
* Partner with Creative and Engineering to test and refine landing page concepts, translating performance findings into clear briefs and iteration recommendations
* Make hands\-on updates directly in the CMS — copy, imagery, and page\-level layout changes — in collaboration with Creative and Engineering; this is working\-level execution, not ownership of CMS strategy, architecture, or governance

**Experimentation \& Engineering Partnership**

* Partner with Engineering to design, scope, and prioritize experiments aimed at improving funnel and conversion performance
* Maintain visibility across all active site experiments — tracked, monitored, and read out consistently
* Generate and follow the data to propose UX and funnel testing that improves the quote and application experience

**Reporting \& Stakeholder Communication**

* Serve as a daily power user of dashboards (Power BI or similar), using them to understand funnel health, traffic performance, SEO/AEO, and experiment status at both a macro business level and a micro diagnostic level
* Leverage SQL, Snowflake, or similar platforms to construct BI reports and uncover digital conversion gaps
* Understand the martech stack, tagging, tracking, and data flows well enough to identify measurement gaps, partner on fixes, and ensure funnel reporting reflects how the customer experience actually works
* Communicate performance insights and recommendations clearly to leadership, translating technical findings into business\-ready narratives
* Act as a connector across Analytics, channel owners, Engineering, Creative, SEO/AEO, and Product Marketing to align insights, priorities, and optimization p

**New York City**


#### **Who We Are**



In today's economy, an increasing number of workers are choosing to freelance. By 2027, half the U.S. workforce will be independent contractors. Yet there is no system of record for this vast self\-employed community and the legions of businesses that increasingly rely on it. A new paradigm is needed to accommodate the future of work that is suddenly no longer in the future. That is what Wingspan is building.



Wingspan is the AI\-native platform for the flexible workforce. Our agents run onboarding and verification, manage work and pay, bill and stay compliant, and support workers on one record, across 1099 contractors, international contractors, and flexible W\-2 employees.



We're a Series B startup based in NYC with backing from some of the best VCs and operators around, including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Touring Capital, and the CEOs and founders of Warby Parker, Harry's, Allbirds, Invision, and Flatiron Health.



Now we're hiring for you: an ambitious individual ready to help build, design, and take us to the next level.



Are you ready to be part of a team redefining the future of work? Apply now!

* As a Sales Development Representative, you'll play a crucial role in breaking into new accounts across all levels of our target customer segments.
* Collaborate with Account Executives, conduct market research to identify potential customers and leads, and qualify those leads.
* Drive Wingspan's outbound prospecting motion, generating sales leads that turn into opportunities and closed business.

This is an **outbound new business development position**. Your main responsibility will be to identify new businesses, contact decision\-makers, introduce HLC Wholesale, and develop new dealer/reseller accounts.

**This is not primarily a customer service or inbound sales position.**

You do not need to be a senior sales executive. We are open to both experienced outbound sales professionals and motivated junior candidates who are comfortable contacting new businesses, handling rejection, and following up consistently.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Research and identify new B2B prospects
* Build your own prospect list using Google, LinkedIn, business directories, and other sources
* Make approximately **30–50 outbound calls and prospecting contacts per day**
* Contact business owners, buyers, store managers, dealers, resellers, installers, and other decision\-makers
* Introduce HLC Wholesale and our dealer/reseller program
* Develop new customer relationships from the first contact
* Follow up with interested prospects by phone and email
* Convert qualified prospects into new dealer accounts and first orders
* Maintain accurate prospect, follow\-up, and sales pipeline information
* Help develop repeat business and long\-term dealer relationships

**Who We Are Looking For**

You may be a good fit if you:

* Are comfortable contacting businesses you have never spoken with before
* Are willing to find new prospects instead of relying only on incoming leads
* Are comfortable making cold calls
* Can hear “not interested” and continue prospecting
* Are persistent with follow\-up
* Communicate clearly and professionally
* Are reliable, organized, and willing to learn
* Are motivated by commission and performance
* Want an opportunity to grow as the company expands

Previous experience in **cold calling, outbound sales, telemarketing, appointment setting, canvassing, door\-to\-door sales, B2B sales, or business development** is preferred, but not required.

Experience in merchant services, telecom, freight/logistics, staffing, insurance, solar, automotive sales, real estate prospecting, security, electronics, or similar outbound sales environments is a plus.

* Comfortable approaching new people

**Find a business → identify the decision\-maker → make the first contact → start a conversation → follow up → develop the account → help generate the first order**

**About Contineo Group**

Welcome to Contineo Group! If you are looking for a workplace that feels like a true community, you've found it. We foster a culture built on trust, flexibility, and the courage to think for ourselves. Our compass guides everything we do: **Show Up, Connect. Deliver.** We believe in lifting you up, clearing the path forward, and providing a supportive space for you to grow into your full potential. Around here, people always come first, and we take real pride in doing honest work we can stand behind.

**About the Role**

Not all Project Coordinator roles are created equal—and we are looking for someone with a very specific skillset. We are seeking a highly organized Site Development Project Coordinator who understands the unique landscape of civil engineering, land development, and commercial construction. In this role, you will be the organizational backbone of our Project Management team, ensuring the seamless execution of developer\-driven site development projects across retail, industrial, restaurants, multifamily, and golf course sectors.

If you know how to navigate municipal permitting, love diving into due diligence research for potential development sites, and can expertly juggle subconsultant coordination, you are exactly who we are looking for. You will bring order and precision to internal workflows, track critical tasks from project setup through closeout, and ensure our engineers have the support they need to deliver craftsmanship.

**A Quick Note Before You Apply:** To be successful in this role, you must have prior experience in the AEC (Architecture, Engineering, and Construction) or land development industry. We love general project managers, but for this specific seat, we need someone who understands site development lifecycles, due diligence, and permitting!

**What You'll Do (The Day\-to\-Day)**

· Due Diligence \& Research: Act as a research analyst by gathering critical project data, zoning codes, and jurisdictional requirements to help developers and Project Managers assess site viability and scope projects accurately.

· Master the Permitting Process: Navigate the complexities of local jurisdictions. Monitor permitting and submission schedules, coordinate document deliveries/retrievals, and keep projects moving through the approval gauntlet.

· Subconsultant Coordination: Manage the moving parts by coordinating with external partners (surveyors, geotechnical engineers, environmental consultants, traffic experts). Ensure subconsultant agreements are completed, named, and stored properly.

· Project Tracking \& Scheduling: Own the project logistics. Use Smartsheet and other tracking tools to monitor deadlines, milestones, and project progress. Assist with scheduling meetings, preparing agendas, and compiling follow\-up action items.

· Document Management: Create initial project folders, maintain proposal content archives, and ensure all contract documents and internal forms are organized. Assist in organizing final deliverables and project closeout documentation.

· Cross\-Functional Support: Review and provide guidance on client invoices, track proposal statuses, and assist in compiling documentation for case studies or marketing use.

**What You Bring to the Table**

**Your Experience \& Technical Toolbox:**

· 2–4 years of project coordination experience specifically within Civil Engineering, Architecture, Land Development, or Commercial Construction (Required).

· Proven experience assisting with site due diligence, permitting processes, and subconsultant coordination.

· Strong working knowledge of digital collaboration platforms (Smartsheet and Google Workspace are heavily utilized here).

· Exceptional file organization, version control habits, and task\-level proficiency in document management tools.

**Your Mindset:**

· You are a master of organization and genuinely detail\-oriented—nothing slips through the cracks on your watch.

· You are a clear, prompt communicator with a team\-oriented support mindset.

· You thrive in a dynamic environment and have the flexibility to handle varied tasks while under the direction of Project Managers.

· You are self\-accountable, proactive, and take immense pride in supporting a team that delivers high\-quality work.

**Why Choose Contineo?**

We promise to show up for you by investing in your growth and well\-being. In return, we ask that you show up for our clients and our team with precision and intent. Here’s how we support your health, financial security, and personal well\-being:

· Health \& Wellness: Medical, Dental, \& Vision insurance, Mental Health Resources, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Long\-Term Disability, and Lactation Accommodation.

· Growth \& Family: Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO), Paid Holidays, Paid Parental \& Maternity Leave, Tuition Reimbursement, real Mentorship \& Coaching, and a Robust Online LMS.

· Financial \& Civic: Competitive Salary, 401(k) Matching, Workers' Compensation, Jury Duty \& Voting Leave, and Military \& Personal Leave.

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $75,000\.00 per year

**About Georgia Tech**
  

Georgia Tech is a top\-ranked public research university situated in the heart of Atlanta, a diverse and vibrant city with numerous economic and cultural strengths. The Institute serves more than 45,000 students through top\-ranked undergraduate, graduate, and executive programs in engineering, computing, science, business, design, and liberal arts. Georgia Tech's faculty attracted more than $1\.4 billion in research awards this past year in fields ranging from biomedical technology to artificial intelligence, energy, sustainability, semiconductors, neuroscience, and national security. Georgia Tech ranks among the nation's top 20 universities for research and development spending and No. 1 among institutions without a medical school.


**Georgia Tech's Mission and Values**
  

Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do:


1\. Students are our top priority.
  

2\. We strive for excellence.
  

3\. We thrive on diversity.
  

4\. We celebrate collaboration.
  

5\. We champion innovation.
  

6\. We safeguard freedom of inquiry and expression.
  

7\. We nurture the wellbeing of our community.
  

8\. We act ethically.

**About the School of Civil \& Environmental Engineering at the Georgia Institute of Technology**
  

The School of Civil and Environmental Engineering at Georgia Tech currently has over 650 undergraduate students, nearly 320 graduate students, 55 tenure\-track faculty members, and 4 Professors of the Practice. Women comprise 50% of the undergraduate population, and more than 29% of the undergraduate student population identifies as a member of under\-represented minority groups. Thirteen faculty members are women, and eight faculty members identify as a member of under\-represented minority groups. Twenty\-six faculty members hold endowed chairs or professorships with 30% of them being women faculty. The School's Strategic Vision is available at www.ce.gatech.edu/strategic\-vision. jobs.description:
Wellness Operations \& Client Experience Coordinator

**Zivel Buckhead \| Atlanta, GA**  
**Full\-Time \| In Person**  
**$33,280–$37,440 per year \+ Performance Bonuses**

About the Opportunity

Zivel Buckhead is looking for an organized, outgoing, and proactive **Wellness Operations \& Client Experience Coordinator** to help support the day\-to\-day operations of our growing wellness and recovery center.

We're looking for someone who can become an important part of the business — someone who enjoys working with customers, stays organized, follows through, takes initiative, and is comfortable wearing a few different hats in a growing environment.

This position combines **customer experience, administrative support, scheduling, lead follow\-up, local marketing, social media communication, events, and business organization.**

You won't spend your entire day sitting behind a desk, and you won't spend your entire day selling.

You'll help make sure customers are taken care of, opportunities don't fall through the cracks, and the business stays organized and continues growing.

What You'll Do

**Customer Experience \& Follow\-Up**

* Welcome and assist customers and prospective customers.
* Respond to customer questions and inquiries by phone, text, email, and social media.
* Follow up with prospective customers, previous visitors, leads, and referral opportunities.
* Help convert customer interest into appointments, visits, memberships, and repeat business.
* Assist with customer onboarding and ongoing communication.
* Help create an exceptional experience before, during, and after each customer's visit.

**Operations \& Administrative Support**

* Help manage scheduling, appointments, calendars, and customer follow\-ups.
* Maintain organized customer information and activity within our CRM.
* Track outstanding tasks and make sure important follow\-ups are completed.
* Assist with documentation, basic reporting, and workflow organization.
* Help improve systems and processes as the business grows.
* Support ownership with administrative and operational priorities.
* Identify things that need attention and take initiative rather than waiting for every task to be assigned.

**Marketing \& Community Engagement**

* Assist with newsletters, promotions, digital content, and local marketing initiatives.
* Respond to social media messages, comments, and customer inquiries.
* Help promote Zivel services, special offers, events, and partnerships.
* Develop relationships with local gyms, wellness professionals, apartment communities, businesses, and other potential referral partners.
* Assist with community events, networking opportunities, partnerships, and promotional activities.
* Help generate ideas for attracting new customers and keeping existing customers engaged.

Who We're Looking For

The right person doesn't necessarily need experience in every area above.

We're more interested in finding someone who is:

* Highly organized and dependable.
* Friendly and confident communicating with customers.
* Proactive and comfortable taking initiative.
* Strong at following through and keeping track of details.
* Comfortable working independently while also being part of a small team.
* Able to shift between customer\-facing responsibilities and administrative work.
* Comfortable using technology, email, social media, scheduling systems, and CRM software.
* Professional and comfortable representing Zivel in the Buckhead community.
* Interested in wellness, fitness, recovery, health, beauty, hospitality, or helping people feel their best.

Experience in **wellness, fitness, healthcare, chiropractic, hospitality, customer service, office administration, executive/administrative support, membership\-based businesses, or small\-business operations** would be especially valuable.

Experience with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Canva, CRM systems, email marketing, scheduling software, or social media is a plus.

The Person Who Will Thrive Here

We're looking for someone who notices what needs to be done and helps get it done.

You might be a great fit if you're the person who naturally keeps things organized, remembers the follow\-up everyone else forgot, communicates well with customers, enjoys solving problems, and likes helping a growing business run more smoothly.

This is an opportunity to have a meaningful role in the growth of a local wellness business rather than being limited to one narrow responsibility.

Compensation

**$33,280–$37,440 per year, based on experience, plus a competitive performance\-based bonus structure.**

The base compensation is separate from the bonus opportunity.

Additional bonuses may be earned based on measurable contributions to areas such as new customers, memberships, appointments, referrals, partnerships, customer retention, and overall business growth.

Schedule

This is a **full\-time, in\-person position at Zivel Buckhead in Atlanta, Georgia.**

Some flexibility may occasionally be needed for networking opportunities, promotional activities, partnerships, or community events.

About Zivel Buckhead

Zivel Buckhead is a wellness and recovery center helping people feel, perform, and recover better through services including cryotherapy, infrared sauna, float therapy, red light therapy, compression, and other innovative wellness and recovery solutions.

We're building a strong wellness community in Buckhead and are looking for someone who wants to help us create an exceptional customer experience while supporting the continued growth of the business.

Pay: $33,280\.00 \- $37,440\.00 per year

* Employee discount

Work Location: In person

The Security Concierge Account Manager serves as the primary leader for onsite Concierge Leads and ensures every site operates consistently through coaching, audits, performance management, and strong client relationships.


During the initial launch and pilot phase of the division, this position is expected to actively work onsite at varying locations approximately one to two days per week to support process mapping, operational design, training execution, and service standard implementation. This position is out of **West Town Senior Satellite Center.** **Fit \& Strong! information**: Fit \& Strong! is a group physical activity and behavior change program for persons with arthritis. The program consists of 24 sessions each lasting 90 minutes. The first 60 minutes focus on flexibility, low\-impact aerobics, and strength training to improve lower body function. The remaining 30 minutes consist of health education and group problem solving using a structured curriculum. Participants develop personalized action plans to maintain physical activity and progress after the class ends. Fit \& Strong! is effective, engaging, and fun – the program has high retention and attendance rates.
Fit \& Strong! is currently offered by community sites across 32 states \+ DC. Fit \& Strong! is recommended by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), the National Council on Aging, the American Physical Therapy Association, and is a Research Tested Intervention Program evaluated by the National Cancer Institute/NIH.
Read more about Fit \& Strong! here: https://fitandstrong.uic.edu/

**Department**


BSD IPP–NPH **About the Department**


The Institute for Population and Precision Health (IPPH), located in the Biological Sciences Division, integrates a wide spectrum of factors such as human health behaviors, environmental factors, social and economic factors, policies and genetic determinants of health, into studies focused on the treatment and prevention of disease, as well as the maintenance of wellness. Leveraging and integrating the University of Chicago’s considerable institutional strength in population science with research spanning diverse fields such as genetic medicine, cancer epidemiology, microbiome, and epigenomics, the Institute will have the common goal of improving human health outcomes. Another major goal of the Institute will be to develop a new multidisciplinary training program to equip researchers with emerging tools and methods to conduct precision health research within a population health framework. Our faculty lead research projects in biostatistics, epidemiology and health services research and participate in interdisciplinary teams with faculty in other departments to address complex problems in health and healthcare, in our communities and around the globe.  

  

**Job Summary**

The Supply \& Logistics Coordinator is responsible for supporting daily fuel supply, logistics, inventory management, reporting, and cost analysis for Road Ranger Travel Centers and potential wholesale customers. This role works closely with suppliers, terminals, common carriers, third\-party logistics providers, internal operations, and the Vice President of Fuels to ensure reliable supply, accurate reporting, efficient deliveries, and cost\-effective fuel sourcing.

Monday through Friday, in\-office, from **1pm to 10p.m.** with some remote working from home optionality. This position also requires participation in nightly supply sourcing rotation. Weekend rotation managing Road Ranger fuels inventory, delivery forecasting, order creation and delivery amendments, and on call for supply issues and common carrier support,  

  

**Education \& Experience*** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Logistics, or a related field preferred.

* Experience in general accounting, financial reporting, reconciliation, and business analysis in a corporate environment preferred.
* Experience with ERP systems, PDI, inventory systems, or fuel management platforms preferred.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications*** Strong organizational skills with strict attention to detail.
* Ability to work under pressure, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple competing deadlines.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross\-functional teams.
* Expert proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
* Strong PowerPoint slide creation skills, including executive\-level and board\-level presentation development.
* Strong data analytics skills, including excel analysis, Power BI, dashboards, reporting, and trend analysis.
* Comfortable presenting analytics, findings, and recommendations to leadership and board\-level audiences.
* Proficient creating, utilizing, analyzing spread sheets, pivot tables V look up, databases, reporting tools, and presentation software effectively.
* Flexible, process\-oriented, and able to identify opportunities for operational improvement.
* High degree of confidentiality, professionalism, and accountability.

**Preferred Qualifications*** Fuel supply, petroleum, terminal, or common carrier logistics experience.

* Knowledge of fuel pricing, rack pricing, freight costs, inventory levels, and delivery scheduling.

jobs.description:
Studios Marketing Agency is looking for an organized, proactive and personable **Part\-Time Partnerships \& Operations Coordinator** to support our growing client roster and founder.

This is a unique hybrid role combining partnership coordination, business development support and light founder/operational assistance. We're looking for someone who loves taking a lot of moving pieces and turning them into a clear plan, keeping conversations moving and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

You'll work closely with the founder of Studios and serve as a point of contact for select client partnerships, helping move opportunities from initial conversation through execution.

**What You'll Do**

**Partnerships \+ Client Coordination**

* Attend select partnership and event\-planning calls on behalf of Studios and our clients
* Communicate with brands, vendors, influencers and local businesses
* Gather pricing, availability, deliverables and event details
* Send follow\-ups and keep partnership conversations moving
* Maintain an organized tracker of active and prospective partnerships
* Turn calls and conversations into clear action items, owners and deadlines
* Coordinate partnership and event logistics
* Create detailed event briefs for Studios' Events \& Content Coordinators
* Ensure event contacts, expectations, timing and content needs are communicated before activations
* Follow up after events and close outstanding loops

**Business Development Support**

* Research prospective Studios clients and relevant decision\-makers
* Build and maintain prospect lists
* Support approved outbound outreach
* Manage follow\-up cadence with prospective clients
* Maintain lead statuses within Studios' CRM and/or Notion
* Flag warm opportunities for the founder
* Help make sure potential new business never falls through the cracks

The founder will continue to lead discovery calls, proposals, pricing and closing conversations.

**Operations \+ Founder Support**

* Review meeting notes and organize action items within Notion
* Maintain clear client and founder priority lists
* Track deadlines and outstanding follow\-ups
* Draft routine emails and communications
* Assist with miscellaneous administrative needs as they arise
* Identify open loops before they become missed deadlines

**What This Role Does Not Own**

This position will not independently determine Studios pricing, contracts, scope changes, high\-level client strategy, financial decisions or significant client\-conflict resolution. Those decisions remain with Studios leadership.

You Might Be a Great Fit If You...

* Are **extremely organized** and naturally follow through
* Can turn a 30\-minute conversation into a beautifully organized action plan
* Communicate confidently and professionally via email and on calls
* Are comfortable representing Studios with clients, partners and vendors
* Take ownership without needing constant direction
* Have strong written communication skills
* Understand social media and modern marketing
* Are comfortable using or learning Notion, Google Workspace and CRM/outreach tools
* Can manage multiple small projects simultaneously
* Are comfortable working directly with a founder in a fast\-moving agency environment

Marketing, PR, events, hospitality, agency or partnership experience is a plus, but strong organization, initiative and communication skills matter most.

**Hours \+ Commitment**

This is a **variable part\-time position averaging approximately 5–10 hours per week.**

Hours may fluctuate depending on client partnership activity, events and business\-development needs. Some weeks may be closer to five hours, while busier weeks may approach 10\.

Most work can be completed remotely and flexibly, but availability for occasional scheduled calls during standard business hours is required.

Chicago\-area candidates are preferred, although we are open to the right remote candidate.

**Compensation**

**$25–$28/hour based on experience**, with the opportunity for responsibilities and hours to grow alongside Studios.

**About Studios Marketing Agency**

Studios Marketing Agency is a full\-service marketing agency built to operate as an extension of our clients' teams. We work across social media, content creation, brand strategy, partnerships, events, digital marketing, websites and more.

We're a small, growing team, which means this role offers hands\-on exposure to multiple brands, direct collaboration with the founder and an opportunity to meaningfully shape how our internal partnership and business\-development processes grow.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your resume along with a brief note answering:

* Why does this role interest you?
* Tell us about a time you were responsible for keeping multiple people, deadlines or moving pieces organized.
* Are you comfortable with a variable schedule of approximately 5–10 hours per week?
* Are you based in Chicago? If not, what time zone are you located in?
* What is your general availability for calls during Monday–Friday business hours?

**Company Description**  

Resultant is a modern consulting firm with a radically different approach to solving problems.

**We don't solve problems for our clients. We solve problems with them.**


Through outcomes driven by data analytics, technology solutions, digital transformation, and beyond, our team works with clients in both the public and private sectors to solve their most complex challenges. We start by learning as much as we can about who they are, how they work, and what they're striving for so we can feel their problems as our own. Partnering with our clients means their desired outcomes are always top of mind, their challenges and strengths guiding our efforts. We build client\-focused relationships before we build unique solutions that blaze past expectations.


Originally founded in Indianapolis as KSM Consulting in 2008, Resultant now employs more than 350 team members who operate from offices around the United States including Indianapolis and Fort Wayne, Indiana; Columbus, Ohio; Lansing, Michigan; Denver, Colorado; Dallas, Texas and Atlanta, Georgia.

**We're Resultant. Clients partner with us to see a difference. People join us to make one.**

 **Job Description**  

Resultant is a data and AI consulting firm serving public sector, commercial, and private equity clients. Our marketing team is small, broad, and highly collaborative. We are looking for a Marketing Coordinator who can help keep the day\-to\-day work moving across channels, campaigns, content, events, and marketing operations.


This is a generalist role. One day you may be publishing a social post or updating a website page; the next, you may be loading a client story into our content library, coordinating a podcast, or pulling campaign performance numbers. You will work across the team rather than own a single channel, helping turn plans into finished work and making sure important details do not get lost.


This role is remote. We are hiring in the Indianapolis and Chicago markets to provide access to clients, events, and team gatherings when needed.

**Responsibilities:**


Web and content operations

* Publish and update pages on our current Wordpress website and support the transition to our new website
* Load and maintain finished content in HubSpot and our internal content hub so sales and delivery teams can easily find and use it

Social and brand presence

* Monitor mentions of Resultant and our people across press, podcasts, partner content, and other channels, and route relevant mentions to the right people and turn strong opportunities into brand content
* Monitor the brand inbox and route inquiries appropriately


Events and podcast

* Support active campaigns and content initiatives with production, coordination, and follow\-through
* Build client stories and other sales enablement content in partnership with marketing managers
* Help track marketing work in Asana and keep tasks, owners, and timelines current
* Shift priorities as needed to support the most important work for the team

* Pull website, social, and campaign performance metrics on a regular cadence
* Help maintain visibility into marketing performance and activity
* Flag anything that looks unusual or worth a closer look. Analytics is a shared responsibility across the team, and this role provides an important set of eyes on the data

 **Qualifications** **QUALIFICATIONS**

* 1–3 years of marketing experience, or internship experience with meaningful hands\-on work and demonstrated output.
* Comfortable using AI as part of your day\-to\-day work. You do not need to be an AI expert or have experience with a specific tool, but you should be curious and experienced in how AI can improve your work, solve problems, automate tasks, and help you learn faster.
* Strong writing skills. You can draft a social post, email, or page update that requires minimal editing
* Highly organized and dependable. You follow through and keep work moving without needing to be reminded.
* Resourceful and a self\-starter. You are comfortable figuring things out when there is not an established playbook, and you identify areas of need and are proactive in offering support and ideas.
* Curious about how our business works and who we serve. Our buyers are varied, and effective marketing requires understanding their needs and context.
* Comfortable working across multiple priorities and collaborating with different members of a marketing team.
* Willing to learn new tools, experiment with new ways of working, and adapt as the team evolves.

**MISSION**



Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we're looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

**POSITION SUMMARY**



The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high\-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.



The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight\-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross\-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow\-through.


**JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Territory Strategy \& Business Performance**


* Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
* Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
* Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high\-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
* Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.


**Strategic Account Management \& Network Development**


* Identify, prioritize, and develop high\-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
* Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision\-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
* Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow\-through.
* Map influence and decision\-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
* Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.


**Clinical Aptitude \& Customer Engagement**


* Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
* Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
* Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
* Execute approved promotional programs, resources, and customer engagements with consistency, clinical relevance, sound judgment, and full adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.


**Influence \& Impact**


* Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.
* Use high emotional intelligence, curiosity, credibility, and thoughtful questioning to build trust with skeptical, change\-resistant, or highly experienced healthcare professionals.
* Influence multiple stakeholders without authority, navigate resistance constructively, and balance persistence with judgment, empathy, and respect for customer boundaries


**Customer, Patient \& Caregiver Impact**


* Keep patients and caregivers at the center of territory and account decisions, with a clear understanding of the journey from disease recognition and diagnosis through treatment initiation and persistence.
* Support a customer experience grounded in trust, empathy, responsiveness, urgency, and reliable follow\-through with healthcare professionals and care teams.
* Collaborate compliantly with Market Access and Patient Services partners to help care teams understand available resources and navigate appropriate barriers in the patient journey.
* Identify recurring customer, access, and patient\-support barriers; elevate them objectively and promptly; and partner with the appropriate internal teams to improve execution and support.

jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are seeking dedicated and detail\-oriented Search Account Managers to join our SEM team. In this role, you manage the creation and execution of PMAX campaigns, Google Ads search, Microsoft Ads search, Tiktok Ads search, and ChatGPT search. Each AM is responsible for reporting, campaign creating and loading, pacing, and daily optimizations to ensure our clients' campaigns succeed. Successful candidates will demonstrate strong attention to detail, effective task prioritization, and excellent organizational skills.

**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Prepare internal and external SEM reporting for clients and team members
* Build, manage and optimize paid search campaigns across Google Ads, Bing Ads and related search networks
* Create, utilize and track conversion metrics like CPA and ROAS
* Design and write ad copy and curate keyword lists to continually improve performance
* Analyze data to improve client return on investment
* Attend and participate in ongoing training sessions and discussions

**BENEFITS**

* Strong compensation plan
* Competitive PTO policy with 22\+ days per year in addition to holiday time off
* Company health insurance plan and paid parental leave
* Flexible schedule with hybrid work environment
* Employer matching retirement contribution after one year of employment
* Quarterly continued education offered and advancement opportunities

* Bachelor’s Degree – Journalism and Business preferred
* 1\-3 years relevant paid search industry experience
* Strong analytical, communication and writing skills
* Experience using Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, etc.)
* Deep understanding of Google Ads and Microsoft Bing
* Solid understanding of basic math, including algebra
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment

**PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS**

* Background knowledge of the digital media landscape and terminology
* Familiarity with platforms such as SEMRush
* Familiarity with pixel creation and tracking conversions
* Google Ads Certified
* Financial, data entry, or media budgeting experience

Pay: $55,000\.00 \- $65,000\.00 per year

* Flexible schedule

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Position Summary:

The Assistant Community Manager greets prospects, processes applications, manages leases and renewals, handles rent collections and evictions, and promotes resident satisfaction and property visibility through effective communication and social media.

* Greet and qualify prospects professionally using guest cards in our Lead Management Software. Assist prospects with applications and deposits, adhering to company procedures and Fair Housing requirements

Completes all necessary paperwork for generating a lease, move\-in, check\-out, and other peak periods in a timely manner

* At least one year of experience in customer service or apartment leasing. A background in accounting combined with customer service is also preferred
* Microsoft Office Suite, Project Management


Qualifications:
**Physical Requirements:*** May be required to sit for extended periods of time while working at a desk
* May be required to climb stairs
* Must be able to read documents, computer screens and data
* Must be able to hear and understand verbal communications in person and over the phone or computer
* May occasionally be required to lift or carry items such as files or office supplies weighing up to 20 pounds
* Must be able to operate a computer, keyboard, mouse and other office equipment

**Work Environment:*** This role is based on site and requires that the employee spend time outside with exposure to the elements

**Administrative / Operations Coordinator**  
**Internationally Recognized Interior Design Firm \| Hollywood, Los Angeles**

A nationally and internationally recognized interior design firm is seeking a highly organized, motivated, and dependable **Administrative / Operations Coordinator** to join our team at our Hollywood office.

This role will work closely with the Principal and design team and is ideal for someone who is hardworking, resourceful, detail\-oriented, and naturally organized. Extensive experience is not required—we are looking for someone with intelligence, initiative, a strong work ethic, and a genuine **can\-do mentality**.

The position includes both **professional and personal administrative support for the Principal**, as well as helping manage the day\-to\-day organization and operations of a busy creative studio.

**Responsibilities include:**

* Managing the Principal’s professional and personal calendars, appointments, scheduling, and reminders
* Assisting with professional and personal organization and day\-to\-day administrative needs
* Supporting the design team with office operations, scheduling, and coordination
* Maintaining internal schedules, deadlines, files, documents, and follow\-up items
* Managing correspondence and helping ensure important tasks are completed and nothing falls through the cracks
* Assisting with basic bookkeeping and accounting\-related organization
* Coordinating appointments, reservations, errands, deliveries, and other administrative needs
* Helping maintain an organized, efficient, and professional office environment
* Stepping in wherever needed to support the Principal and team

**The ideal candidate:**

* Is exceptionally organized and detail\-oriented
* Is hardworking, dependable, and takes pride in getting things done well
* Is proactive and able to anticipate what needs to happen next
* Has excellent communication skills and follow\-through
* Is comfortable balancing professional and personal responsibilities
* Is discreet and understands the importance of confidentiality
* Is resourceful and comfortable solving problems independently
* Thrives in a fast\-paced, creative environment
* Has a positive, solutions\-oriented attitude and believes no task is too small
* **Must like dogs and be comfortable having dogs in the office**
* **Must have reliable personal transportation and a valid driver’s license**

Knowledge of **QuickBooks is a plus, but not required.** Previous experience in interior design, architecture, fashion, or another creative industry is helpful, but not necessary.

We are less concerned with an extensive résumé and more interested in finding the **right person—someone smart, capable, hardworking, organized, and eager to become an important part of the studio.**

**Position:** Full\-time, in\-office  
**Location:** Hollywood, Los Angeles

Pay: $26\.40 \- $31\.79 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Great brands reflect culture. The best ones help shape it. At Foot Locker, we’re rooted in sport, powered by style, and driven by the communities that move both. As part of the DICK’S Sporting Goods family, you’re backed by the resources, reach, and career opportunities of a world\-class sports company. That unleashes Foot Locker to keep pushing forward with the agility and edge that define the brand.
