new_jobs.title: Entry Level Account Manager - Los Angeles, CA
new_jobs.description:
Medical Diagnostic Laboratories (MDL), a member of Genesis Global Group, is a CLIA certified clinical laboratory with multiple state licensing, specializing in state of the art, automated DNA based molecular analysis of a variety of chronic and infectious illnesses.
  
  

MDL specializes and performs Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) with a larger menu of testing available in the field of infectious disease. Our main theme of research is in the field of Gynecology, Infectious Diseases, Infectious Arthritis, Tick\-borne Diseases, Mycology, and Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (CFS).
  
  

MDL is looking to expand its sales force throughout the U.S. We are seeking a high\-energy, self\-motivated individual to join our sales team. As an Entry Level Account Manager, you will be responsible for maintaining a large client base of existing customers for MDL and serve as a liaison between management and customers to resolve any customer issues.
  
  

**Essential Functions:**  

* Grow client base revenues by presenting new test information, up selling and seeking out new sources of revenue from existing clients
* Establish positive long\-term client relations
* Educate and train clients, research problems and coordinate solutions between the laboratory and client
* Work closely with Senior Sales Executive and Regional Manager to identify client concerns and assist in the development and implementation of client retention strategies
* Monitor, evaluate, and report level of client satisfaction and recommend appropriate corrective action as required
* Maintain knowledge of competitors and their presence in assigned territory


**Job Qualifications:** General Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSA’s) required
  
* 1\-3 years of successful customer service experience.
* Well\-developed multi\-tasking, organizational skills, and detail orientation are key to success
* Energy, motivation, enthusiasm, and integrity
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Must demonstrate sound judgment and decision\-making ability
* Computer proficiency in MS Office, Excel, e\-mail and internet functions
* Knowledge of laboratory testing and competing products.
* Must be able to travel within the coverage area and occasionally nationwide


**Physical Demands:** Physical, Mental and Workplace Environment Conditions
  
* Use hands to handle, control, or feel objects, tools, or controls
* Ability to sit, stand and walk
* Ability to drive motor vehicle


**Workplace Conditions:** Workplace Environment Conditions
  
* Requires frequent traveling by motor vehicle
* May be exposed to various workplace environments when meeting with customers


**Education and Certifications:**  

* Medical Assistant certification or Associate Degree, BA/BS preferred.


**We Offer:**  

* Uncapped Incentive Payout Plan
* Company Car
* Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability
* Life Insurance
* Dependent Care Flex Spending Account
* Voluntary Policies (Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness \& Supplemental STD)
* Identity Theft Protection
* 401(k) Plan
* Paid Vacation \& Holiday
* Business Professional Environment


Visit us at http://www.mdlab.com
  
  

Medical Diagnostic Laboratories, LLC is an equal opportunity employer.

new_jobs.description:
**Marketing Associate**

**Salary:** $65,000–$85,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Location:** Orange, CA – In Person

**About Hampton Tedder Electric**

Hampton Tedder Electric Co. (HTE) was established in 1958 and is a family\-owned and operated high\-voltage electrical contractor with a proven track record of safe, compliant, and reliable service.

We provide high\-voltage design, construction, maintenance, and testing for overhead, underground, and underwater high\-voltage systems.

We are seeking a motivated, creative, and highly organized **Marketing Associate** to join our team and support the company's marketing, communications, brand, and business development activities.

This is a hands\-on, mid\-level marketing position for someone who enjoys variety and is comfortable working on multiple projects at the same time. The Marketing Associate will work closely with company leadership, business development, operations, project teams, and outside vendors to create and coordinate marketing materials and communications that accurately represent HTE's capabilities, people, projects, and accomplishments.

The ideal candidate is a strong writer and communicator with excellent attention to detail, good organizational skills, and a willingness to learn the high\-voltage electrical and construction industry.

This position offers an excellent opportunity for a marketing professional who wants to build experience in **construction, electrical contracting, utilities, infrastructure, and business\-to\-business marketing.**

**Position Summary**

The Marketing Associate will support the day\-to\-day execution of the company's marketing activities across digital, print, social media, events, email, website content, promotional materials, and business development support.

The successful candidate will help ensure that HTE presents a consistent, professional, and compelling image across all marketing channels.

This position is primarily focused on **execution and coordination**, with opportunities to take ownership of individual projects and initiatives as experience and knowledge of the company grow.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Marketing \& Brand Support**

* Support the execution of marketing initiatives aligned with company and business development objectives.
* Help maintain consistent company branding across marketing materials and communications.
* Assist with the creation and updating of brochures, presentations, capability statements, advertisements, flyers, business cards, promotional materials, and other marketing collateral.
* Ensure marketing materials are accurate, professional, visually appealing, and consistent with company standards.
* Assist with gathering project information, photographs, employee information, technical details, and other content needed for marketing materials.
* Maintain an organized library of company logos, photographs, project information, marketing materials, and other brand assets.
* Research competitors, industry trends, publications, events, and marketing opportunities as requested.

**Digital \& Social Media**

* Assist with managing the company's social media presence.
* Create, schedule, and publish content across appropriate social media platforms.
* Help maintain a social media content calendar.
* Develop content highlighting company projects, employees, accomplishments, safety initiatives, community involvement, capabilities, and industry activities.
* Monitor social media activity and engagement and provide updates to management.

* Track basic email and digital marketing metrics and help identify opportunities for improvement.

**Trade Shows \& Industry Events**

* Assist with planning and coordinating trade shows, conferences, industry events, company events, and other marketing activities.
* Coordinate event materials, booth graphics, signage, literature, promotional items, giveaways, and other supplies.
* Assist with event logistics, registration, shipping, setup, and breakdown as needed.
* Help coordinate company representatives attending events.
* Assist with pre\-event communications and post\-event follow\-up.
* Help track contacts and leads generated through trade shows and industry events.
* Research relevant industry events and make recommendations to management.

**Content Development**

* Write, edit, proofread, and format marketing content for a variety of audiences and platforms.
* Create content for social media, website pages, email campaigns, newsletters, brochures, presentations, advertisements, and other marketing materials.
* Assist with developing project descriptions, company capability descriptions, employee biographies, and other marketing content.
* Interview employees and project personnel to gather information about projects, accomplishments, safety initiatives, and company activities.
* Help translate technical information into clear and compelling content for customers and general audiences.
* Collect and organize project photography, employee photographs, videos, testimonials, and other content.
* Assist with maintaining current employee resumes and project information used in proposals and business development activities.

**Proposal \& Business Development Support**

* Assist with preparation and formatting of Statements of Qualifications and capability packages.

new_jobs.title: B2B Outside Sales Representative
new_jobs.description:
Overview:
**If You’re the Best at Sales, You Have a Place with the** **Best in Pests**  

As part of the Orkin Commercial sales team, you get the advantage of a highly persuasive pitch: top\-notch service from an iconic brand name and the industry leader with almost 125 years of protecting homes and businesses. That’s backed by award\-winning training that ensures the professionalism and expertise of all Orkin Pros and the Orkin Guarantee that demonstrates our commitment to customer satisfaction.  

This role combines your competitive drive and your desire to be part of a talented team. You’ll have the opportunity to maximize your financial potential with high\-performance sales skills and contribute to the overall success of the business. And you can earn your way to an annual rewards trip honoring top performers, not to mention chart a path to leadership opportunities.  

You’ll have **more than a job**—you’ll have a **career with growth potential and benefits** that go beyond the basics. This includes a company vehicle, competitive pay and a 401(k) program. Not to mention, you’ll receive **opportunities to volunteer and give back** so that everyone has a safe place to live, work, and play. Work alongside a team that values safety, professionalism, empathy, integrity and innovation in pursuit of our mission to deliver the peace of mind only an Orkin Pro can provide.  

With Orkin’s award\-winning training program, you’ll **receive all the tools you need to succeed**. That means no industry experience required to start building your career. Plus, if there’s one thing we know at Orkin, it’s that pests keep coming back, and that makes our industry recession resistant.  

**Ready to start a career with staying power?** **Apply now!**  


Responsibilities:

As an **Outside Sales Rep**, you’ll be responsible for understanding Orkin’s products and services and how to sell them to a variety of industries. You’ll make strategic recommendations to new and existing customers to help prevent pests, uphold quality and safety, and satisfy their regulatory standards. You’ll solve problems and build trusted relationships as an essential partner protecting their business. Adept at listening to needs and clearly explaining practical solutions, you can win over customers with confidence and care.
**You will…*** Prioritize **safety** in all responsibilities
* Conduct yourself with the utmost **professionalism** and **integrity** with customers and coworkers.
* Serve as an **empathetic** problem solver for commercial customers by utilizing the in\-depth training provided to recommend the best **innovative** overall solution for each customer's needs.
* Achieve sales goals through prospecting new business and assigned leads.
* Utilizing marketing tools to drive new business development.
* Conduct an inspection of the interior and exterior of the customer’s commercial property—don’t worry, we teach you how!
* Make recommendations to customers based on your inspection and issues identified by addressing any questions, explaining the solution, and setting expectations so they have peace of mind about their pest program.
* Use the iPad we provide to prepare sales agreements and help you stay organized—we will provide training on this too!

**We Offer…*** **Estimated first\-year earnings: $60,000 \- $120,000 USD annually**
* **Base plus uncapped commission**
* **Company vehicle with gas card after training is completed**
* Company provided iPhone and iPad with sales software
* Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, maternity, \& life Insurance
* 401(k) plan with company match, employee stock purchase plan
* Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave
* Employee discounts, tuition reimbursement, dependent scholarship awards
* Industry leading, quality, comprehensive training program

**Why Orkin?*** You’re seeking an opportunity with career potential in a reliable, recession\-resistant industry
* You have a service\-oriented mindset that leads you to build loyalty and trust with customers
* You hold yourself responsible to commitments
* You value being part of a team
* You want to keep learning, improving and developing as a leader
* You want to join a company that supports the community
* **You want a career with a purpose at a mission\-driven company that values**
	+ *Safety*
	+ *Professionalism*
	+ *Empathy*
	+ *Integrity*
	+ *Innovation*


Qualifications:
**Minimum Requirements:*** **No Experience Required!! Sales experience preferred**
* High School Diploma or equivalent required
* Valid driver’s license required
* Ability to obtain the appropriate pesticide license/certification if required (company paid)
* Ability to work in the field independently and interact with our great clients

**Physical Demands / Working Conditions:**


Candidates must meet physical job requirements and safely perform the job duties with or without accommodations:

* Safely use a ladder within the manufacturer's weight capacity
* Occasionally lift and carry up to 50 lbs.
* Safely access crawl spaces, attics, confined spaces, roof tops, etc. including the ability to climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl
* Wear personal protective equipment (PPE) which sometimes requires an OSHA\-compliant respirator
* Willing to work in different types of weather conditions

 *Orkin is an Equal Opportunity/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities Employer*

**About Thyseed (USA)**

Thyseed is a premium baby\-feeding brand focused on helping parents through stressful feeding needs by bringing their babies high quality, trusted baby bottles and other feeding products. This role will lead Thyseed’s US social media content planning and creation, short\-form video production, static asset production, product storytelling, and day\-to\-day social media platform management. It is about turning real parent problems into clear, relatable, and high\-performing content.You will help Thyseed communicate with US parents in a natural voice across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest, Amazon, DTC, and other digital channels. * Improve US\-native tone and relevance of Thyseed’s digital content

**Qualifications**

* 8\+ years of experience in content creation, social media management, short\-form video production, copywriting, graphic design and other digital content.

Please submit your resume and a short note explaining why you are interested in helping build Thyseed’s US brand. new_jobs.title: Office Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**About WCN**


Wildlife Conservation Network is a rapidly growing leader in wildlife conservation, protecting endangered wildlife by supporting conservationists who ensure wildlife and people coexist and thrive. Using a collaborative, entrepreneurial, innovative, and philanthropically generous approach, WCN gives conservation leaders access to the donors, resources, and tools they need to reverse the crises facing threatened species — raising philanthropic funding and channeling it to a vetted network of Conservation Partners and through species\-focused Wildlife Funds that support over 125 species in more than 50 countries. This is a hybrid role with anticipated 3\-4 days in office.

**Position Summary**


The Office Operations Coordinator keeps WCN's office, facilities, technology, events logistics, and finance\-support functions running day to day. This is a generalist role by design — the person in it moves across a wide range of tasks and prioritizes what's most urgent on a given day — and it's a strong entry point into nonprofit operations for someone early in their career who wants to grow. Reporting to the CFO, this role supports the whole organization and works most visibly alongside Donor Engagement and Events around Expo and other donor\-facing events.

**Mission, Vision \& Values Alignment**


This role keeps the operational backbone of WCN — office, technology, events, and finance\-support functions — running smoothly, freeing the organization to focus on its Conservation Partners, Wildlife Funds, and Rising Wildlife Leaders work in the field. It lives WCN's values directly: *Service* (the role exists to support other teams' work), *Integrity* (trustworthy handling of financially sensitive tasks like check deposits and petty cash), *Community* (visitor hospitality and internal culture/engagement support), and *Collaboration* (close partnership with Finance, Donor Engagement, and Events).

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Office \& Facilities** — Keep the physical office running day to day: phone coverage, visitor reception, supplies and systems, vendor relationships (e.g., janitorial), and a well\-organized, well\-used physical space.
* **Administrative Support** — Keep WCN organized and staff supported: general inquiries, mail, filing, new\-hire onboarding logistics, shared calendars, and employee engagement activities.
* **Finance Support** — Own the day\-to\-day financial tasks that keep operations running cleanly: check deposits (primary owner), petty cash, vendor invoices and payments, subscription tracking, and monthly credit card reconciliation, in close partnership with the Finance team.
* **Technology \& Equipment** — Maintain WCN's computer/equipment inventory and serve as the primary point of contact with WCN's IT support vendor.
* **Events \& Cross\-Team Support** — Coordinate staff and partner travel bookings and expense reporting, and support logistics for internal and external events, including Expo (storage, merchandise, partner packages).
* **Ad Hoc** — Take on cross\-departmental administrative support and special projects (Development, Programs, Finance) as they come up.

**Qualifications**

* 1\-3 years of office/administrative experience
* Strong general computer and technology skills (e.g., spreadsheets, documents, presentation software)
* Experience with cloud\-based collaborative tools (Google Drive, email); willingness to learn Salesforce basics with training
* Experience answering/routing calls on a multi\-line phone system or serving in a front\-desk/reception role
* Experience coordinating with vendors or service providers (scheduling, ordering, basic contract/invoice tracking)
* Familiarity with mail/shipping logistics (USPS, UPS, FedEx)
* Fluent in English, with strong verbal and written communication skills
* Comfortable with variety and frequent interruptions (phones, visitors, vendors) rather than sustained single\-task focus; self\-directed enough to keep a long list of recurring tasks moving without close daily supervision
* Must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship
* Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds and sit for extended periods, with or without reasonable accommodation
* Genuine interest in wildlife conservation and strong alignment with WCN's Core Values

**Compensation \& Benefits**


Compensation is expected to be in the $33\-36 an hour range based on qualifications and experience. Benefits include: medical, dental, and vision insurance contributions; chiropractic/acupuncture; basic life insurance and AD\&D Health FSA and dependent care (pre\-tax); a retirement plan with a 100% employer match on employee contributions up to 6% of salary; 11 paid holidays plus 1 paid floating holiday; 15 days of paid vacation in the first year (\+1 day per year worked); paid sick leave; and employee wellness, mental health, and discount programs.

**Equal Opportunity**


WCN is committed to the principles of being an equal opportunity employer (EOE). WCN’s organizational policies, practices, programs, activities and decisions regarding employment are not based on a person’s race, color, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, parental status, housing status, or other protected status, in accordance with applicable law. Black, Indigenous, people of color, women, individuals identifying with the LGBTQIA\+ community, or members of other underrepresented groups in the conservation sector are strongly encouraged to apply.

**About Blueprint**



Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Onsite: Willing to work across Mountain View(1 day) and Santa Clara (4 days) office locations.

Blueprint believes that healthy, supported employees do their best work. Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that may include:

new_jobs.description:
NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing to take on problems ordinary computers cannot! We innovate at the intersection of computer graphics, high performance computing, and artificial intelligence. Accelerated computing is reshaping trillion\-dollar industries like transportation, healthcare, and manufacturing, and fostering entirely new industries just taking root. We're building a company, one that makes unique and contributions to the world. We want to attract the world's best people in our field, give them a place to do their life's work, where they can build a great life, and promise never to squander their talents. Our company is designed to evolve quickly to address new opportunities, making clear, timely internal and external communication of our business strategy a top priority.


Our Executive Communications team partners closely with NVIDIA’s CEO and senior leaders to shape how the company shows up across social platforms, stages, screens, meetings, and media. We are looking for an exceptional writer and social media strategist to lead the day\-to\-day social presence of NVIDIA’s executives. You will help inform editorial strategy, spotting timely opportunities to drafting, refining, and publishing distinctive content in an authentic executive voice. The remaining focus will be on select internal and external communications, including projects like annual report, CSR letter, and Stockholder Day.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Lead the editorial strategy, planning and day\-to\-day execution of social media for highly visible executives.
* Draft and refine compelling, platform\-native social content that captures the executive’s voice, perspective, and priorities across product launches, company milestones, industry developments and relevant moments in the news cycle.
* Build and manage a proactive editorial calendar while staying ready to respond quickly to emerging opportunities, fast\-moving events, and executive priorities.
* Identify strong story angles and turn complex technical, business, and policy topics into clear, engaging short\-form narratives for audiences around the world.
* Partner with creative and cross\-functional teams to develop social\-first storytelling across text, images, and video, and use performance insights to continually improve content and audience engagement.
* Manage the social content workflow from idea through review, approval, publishing, and measurement, exercising excellent judgment around timing, tone, accuracy, and risk.
* Extend keynote, launch, and company messaging into distinctive social content and other materials for broader executive use. Partner closely with PR, Marketing, Government Affairs, Investor Relations, Legal, Product, Engineering, Research, and other teams to gather inputs and align messaging quickly.
* Take the first pen on select long\-form and internal executive communications, including the CSR letter, Stockholder Day materials, employee messages, remarks, talking points, Q\&A, and briefing documents.
* Learn and help maintain the voice, priorities, and recurring themes that define NVIDIA's story, ensuring consistency across short\- and long\-form executive content.
* Build repeatable processes and content systems that improve editorial planning, writing, approvals, measurement, and knowledge sharing across the Executive Communications team.

**What We Need to See:**

* 8\+ years of experience in executive social media, executive communications, journalism, or related roles, ideally in technology.
* Significant experience owning social strategy and writing for a C\-suite leader, founder, public figure, or similarly high\-profile voice.
* Outstanding writing and editing skills, with the ability to capture a leader's voice and move fluently between sharp, concise social content and polished long\-form communications.
* A strong understanding of social platforms, editorial planning, audience behavior, content formats, publishing workflows, and performance measurement.
* Excellent news judgment and the ability to synthesize fast\-changing inputs, launches, current events, and business context into timely, credible executive content.
* Strong collaboration skills and executive presence, with the ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders and cross\-functional teams.
* The ability to operate calmly in a fast\-paced environment, prioritize ruthlessly, and handle sensitive information with discretion.
* Bachelors degree or equivalent experience

**Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:**

* Experience building and running the social presence of a founder, CEO, or globally visible executive.
* A strong portfolio of executive social content that demonstrates voice, range, timeliness, editorial judgment, and measurable audience impact, alongside examples of long\-form corporate or executive writing.
* Experience developing social\-first visual and video storytelling in partnership with creative teams. Experience building scalable editorial processes, content calendars, repositories, approval workflows, or measurement systems.
* Background in AI, semiconductors, enterprise technology, public policy, or financial communications.
* Thoughtful use of AI tools to improve research and workflow speed without sacrificing judgment, originality, accuracy, or voice.


NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

* Opportunity to learn different ethnic segments
* Monthly and annual sales rewards and recognition

This is an outside sales position responsible for promoting the company's products and services and for building relationships with new and existing accounts. The main focus is to help Sysco customers succeed while achieving sales and profit goals established by the company. This position may require working some non\-traditional hours (evening, weekends, and holidays) to successfully meet customers' needs.

* Develop new business, penetrate existing accounts, and minimize lost business to achieve profitable sales growth and special objectives within assigned territory.
* Seek and qualify prospects following company account stratification goals.

* Evaluate market trends and recommend products to customers, based on business needs and goals.
* Be informed of market conditions, product innovations, and competitors' products, prices, and sales; share information with customers as part of value\-added services provided.
* Answer customers' questions about products, prices, availability, and product use.
* Provide product information and practical training to customer personnel.
* Drive personal vehicle to customer accounts, conventions, company meetings, etc.
* Communicate and collect accounts receivable as necessary, working with the credit department and client; collect all balances due based on approved credit terms.

* Participate in company functions, promotions, customer visits, and customer events.
* Attend and participate in general sales and district meetings.
* Engage in ongoing training sessions.
* Assist with the training of new employees as requested.
* Review and analyze daily and weekly reports such as special\-order requests, customer bid files, and sales/gross profit margin data.
* Perform administrative duties, such as preparing sales budgets and reports, maintaining sales records, processing credits, and pick\-up requests, preparing sales quotes and menu suggestions, and filing reports.

* Restaurant Management, Foodservice Outside Sales, Chef Experience preferred

* Current automobile insurance with the following limits of liability: Bodily injury \- $100,000 each person and $300,000 each accident; property damage \- $100,000 is required

 **Requirement**

* Pass employment testing
* Must sign Sysco Protective Covenants Agreement.
* Reside or willing to relocate to the geographical vicinity of territory.

 **Professional Skills**

* Basic PC skills and proficiency with MS Office.
* Ability to read, write, speak English.

* Building Trust

* Managing Work

new_jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About XLI**
At XLI, we build more than just structures. We build careers, relationships, and the future. As a purpose\-driven general contractor, our culture is grounded in servant leadership, accountability, and collaboration. Our Assistant Project Managers are integral to driving success across our projects and shaping the future of construction.  

**Position Summary**
The Assistant Project Manager (APM) plays a critical role in supporting the successful planning and execution of construction projects. In partnership with the Project Manager and Superintendent, the APM oversees documentation, procurement, budgeting, schedule adherence, and quality control. This role is ideal for a dynamic builder with strong attention to detail, leadership capabilities, and a passion for continuous learning.  

**Key Responsibilities*** Review contracts, assess risk, and communicate key areas of exposure to the project team.
* Lead the bid process by developing detailed instructions to bidders, ensuring scope coverage, accuracy, and appropriate risk mitigation.
* Support subcontractor buyout and selection processes, including subcontract execution and issue resolution.
* Assemble and manage the project control estimate.
* Manage all aspects of construction management, including:
* Preconstruction

The Center for Computational Neuroscience (CCN) is currently seeking a full\-time Administrative Coordinator to support the growing financial and administrative operations of the Center in a collaborative environment.

**ESSENTIAL** **FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for guests and build positive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Provide administrative support to CCN’s scientific leadership, including managing calendars, scheduling meetings, preparing expense reports and assisting with other tasks as needed.
* Support CCN’s scientific programming, including seminars, workshops and group lab meetings. Responsibilities may include coordinating with organizers and speakers, arranging travel, processing reimbursements, managing calendars, and ordering catering.

* Proactively coordinate internal and external CCN activities, including scheduling appointments and arranging travel for conference participation, in partnership with the Events team.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree

 **Experience**

* At least two years of experience providing high\-level administrative support, including project management.
* Experience managing complex calendars, coordinating travel and handling confidential information.
* Experience in a scientific research or academic environment is preferred.

**Related Skills \& Other Requirements**

* Strong organizational skills, consistent accuracy and careful attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple complex assignments and priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency with word\-processing, spreadsheet and database software in a macOS environment.
* Experience using cloud\-based applications such as Google Workspace, Dropbox and Concur.
* Resourcefulness, sound judgment and the ability to take ownership of responsibilities with minimal supervision.
* Ability to handle sensitive information with a high level of confidentiality and discretion.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders and contribute to a positive, team\-oriented culture.
* Willingness and ability to work occasional evenings.

**REQUIRED APPLICATION MATERIALS**

* Please submit a résumé and cover letter stating your interest in the position.

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS**

* In addition to competitive salaries, the Simons Foundation provides employees with a comprehensive benefits package.

Many of the greatest ideas and discoveries come from a diverse mix of minds, backgrounds, and experiences. This is much more than sitting behind a front desk. We’re looking for someone who genuinely enjoys people, brings positive energy into a space, takes initiative, works well as part of a team, and is comfortable helping promote our classes, services, workshops and trainings.

new_jobs.title: Junior Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Hey there!
  

We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.



Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting\-edge technology and data\-driven approach, we're revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
  

  

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in \+55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.



Our results? We've teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award\-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?



To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar\-raisers with a hands\-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!  

  

Ready to be part of the experience?



Now, let's discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever's mission.


As part of the Fever Originals team, you will use data and insights to create one\-of\-a\-kind events and experiences that allow people to have unforgettable moments.


**Who you'll work with**  

  

You will join one of our offices around the world to work in teams and directly interact with our partners, providers, and venues.  

  

In this role you will help Fever grow its pipeline of original events. To do so, you will interact with all departments of Fever, from Marketing to Operations.  

  

The team you're about to join consists of people that are motivated, young, and fun. On top of having multicultural backgrounds, people in the team are all top profiles: McKinsey, Amazon, Google, KKR, Cirque du Soleil, PSG, and Roland Garros.



Employees are expected to be in the office Monday to Thursday with possibility to work from home on Fridays.  

  

**What you'll do**  

  

**As a Project Manager, you will work with your team lead to develop, launch and manage your events, from A to Z. Together with the other departments, you will define the way to scale this event to all our other markets.**  

**You will be responsible for owning the strategic planning, execution, and reporting for our key strategic scalable experiences.**

  


When you join Fever, you are joining a company that will invest in your professional development. You will receive training and coaching on how to:


* **Provide a detailed analysis of business opportunities and inefficiencies; proposing changes to operational processes; driving a high standard in customer satisfaction; ensuring high\-quality experiences are delivered.**
* Work with the Fever marketing team to make sure events make an impact: both in terms of ticket sales and coverage
* Manage, report on, and grow revenue from scalable events
* Grow the scalable experiences against team targets
* Help to scale the events to our other cities through developing and sharing best practices (opportunity for travel)
* Foster and grow the Fever Partner Network: including venues and event organizers
* Communicate product needs (Fever usability) and process needs to HQ, work with product/engineering to deliver on themRepresent Fever at local events and with local PR
  


**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* 1\+ years in a project management role or consulting background. This is not a position for an events background.
* Fluent English.
* Huge appetite for learning and the ability to pick up new skills quickly. You will also have strong analytical, relationship management, and organizational skills.
* You'll be solution\-focused, identifying problem areas and then creating plans to find resolutions.
* You'll have strong communication skills and a proven track record of building positive working relationships.
* Highly organized and efficient
* Curious and keen to push boundaries and try new concepts
* Great networking skills and the ability to make smart partnerships happen
* Able to communicate with events partners, brands, agencies, and talent on efforts
* Ability to think strategically when faced with an events partnership brief or with our proprietary data on what events work
* Able to handle large amounts of work and parallel work\-streams
* Collaborative and willing to get hands dirty and work on all required events tasks
* Knowledge of promotional tools such as Facebook and Instagram is a plus
* Strong academic background is a plus


You can expect to join a group of diverse, hardworking team players, where a cultural fit is someone willing to stay humble and learn and can work nimbly. We welcome applications with unusual backgrounds with the expectation that the applicant will have acquired hard or soft skills and maturity throughout their experiences.

  

**What you'll get**


* Opportunity to have a real impact in a high\-growth global category leader
* Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance (total compensation of around 70\-75k)
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Gympass Memberships
* 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
* Work in a location in the heart of Manhattan
* Responsibility from day one with strong opportunities for professional growth
* Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!


**Our hiring process**


* A 30 min video call with one of our Talent Acquisition Managers, to better understand your career plan, assess cultural fit and answer any questions you may have
* A 60 min online test with three topics: logic, analytics and written understanding
* A 30 min interview with your future manager
* A 45 min video call with your future manager, including questions about your profile and a business case presentation (to be prepared in advance)


On average our process lasts 20 working days and offers usually follow within

**Site Development Project Coordinator**

*Location: Downtown Decatur, GA (On\-site, MARTA Accessible) \| Reports To: Project Manager \| Schedule: Full\-Time, Mon\-Fri (8:30 AM – 5:30 PM)*

**About Contineo Group**

Welcome to Contineo Group! If you are looking for a workplace that feels like a true community, you've found it. We foster a culture built on trust, flexibility, and the courage to think for ourselves. Our compass guides everything we do: **Show Up, Connect. Deliver.** We believe in lifting you up, clearing the path forward, and providing a supportive space for you to grow into your full potential. Around here, people always come first, and we take real pride in doing honest work we can stand behind.

**About the Role**

Not all Project Coordinator roles are created equal—and we are looking for someone with a very specific skillset. We are seeking a highly organized Site Development Project Coordinator who understands the unique landscape of civil engineering, land development, and commercial construction. In this role, you will be the organizational backbone of our Project Management team, ensuring the seamless execution of developer\-driven site development projects across retail, industrial, restaurants, multifamily, and golf course sectors.

If you know how to navigate municipal permitting, love diving into due diligence research for potential development sites, and can expertly juggle subconsultant coordination, you are exactly who we are looking for. You will bring order and precision to internal workflows, track critical tasks from project setup through closeout, and ensure our engineers have the support they need to deliver craftsmanship.

**A Quick Note Before You Apply:** To be successful in this role, you must have prior experience in the AEC (Architecture, Engineering, and Construction) or land development industry. We love general project managers, but for this specific seat, we need someone who understands site development lifecycles, due diligence, and permitting!

**What You'll Do (The Day\-to\-Day)**

· Due Diligence \& Research: Act as a research analyst by gathering critical project data, zoning codes, and jurisdictional requirements to help developers and Project Managers assess site viability and scope projects accurately.

· Master the Permitting Process: Navigate the complexities of local jurisdictions. Monitor permitting and submission schedules, coordinate document deliveries/retrievals, and keep projects moving through the approval gauntlet.

· Subconsultant Coordination: Manage the moving parts by coordinating with external partners (surveyors, geotechnical engineers, environmental consultants, traffic experts). Ensure subconsultant agreements are completed, named, and stored properly.

· Project Tracking \& Scheduling: Own the project logistics. Use Smartsheet and other tracking tools to monitor deadlines, milestones, and project progress. Assist with scheduling meetings, preparing agendas, and compiling follow\-up action items.

· Document Management: Create initial project folders, maintain proposal content archives, and ensure all contract documents and internal forms are organized. Assist in organizing final deliverables and project closeout documentation.

· Cross\-Functional Support: Review and provide guidance on client invoices, track proposal statuses, and assist in compiling documentation for case studies or marketing use.

**What You Bring to the Table**

**Your Experience \& Technical Toolbox:**

· 2–4 years of project coordination experience specifically within Civil Engineering, Architecture, Land Development, or Commercial Construction (Required).

· Proven experience assisting with site due diligence, permitting processes, and subconsultant coordination.

· Strong working knowledge of digital collaboration platforms (Smartsheet and Google Workspace are heavily utilized here).

· Exceptional file organization, version control habits, and task\-level proficiency in document management tools.

**Your Mindset:**

· You are a master of organization and genuinely detail\-oriented—nothing slips through the cracks on your watch.

· You are a clear, prompt communicator with a team\-oriented support mindset.

· You thrive in a dynamic environment and have the flexibility to handle varied tasks while under the direction of Project Managers.

· You are self\-accountable, proactive, and take immense pride in supporting a team that delivers high\-quality work.

**Why Choose Contineo?**

We promise to show up for you by investing in your growth and well\-being. In return, we ask that you show up for our clients and our team with precision and intent. Here’s how we support your health, financial security, and personal well\-being:

· Health \& Wellness: Medical, Dental, \& Vision insurance, Mental Health Resources, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Long\-Term Disability, and Lactation Accommodation.

· Growth \& Family: Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO), Paid Holidays, Paid Parental \& Maternity Leave, Tuition Reimbursement, real Mentorship \& Coaching, and a Robust Online LMS.

· Financial \& Civic: Competitive Salary, 401(k) Matching, Workers' Compensation, Jury Duty \& Voting Leave, and Military \& Personal Leave.

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $75,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

------------

  

Georgia Tech prides itself on its technological resources, collaborations, high\-quality student body, and its commitment to building an outstanding and diverse community of learning, discovery, and creation. We strongly encourage applicants whose values align with our institutional values, as outlined in our strategic plan. These values include academic excellence, diversity of thought and experience, inquiry and innovation, collaboration and community, and ethical behavior and stewardship. Georgia Tech has policies to promote a healthy work\-life balance and is aware that attracting faculty may require meeting the needs of two careers.


**About Georgia Tech**
  

Georgia Tech is a top\-ranked public research university situated in the heart of Atlanta, a diverse and vibrant city with numerous economic and cultural strengths. The Institute serves more than 45,000 students through top\-ranked undergraduate, graduate, and executive programs in engineering, computing, science, business, design, and liberal arts. Georgia Tech's faculty attracted more than $1\.4 billion in research awards this past year in fields ranging from biomedical technology to artificial intelligence, energy, sustainability, semiconductors, neuroscience, and national security. Georgia Tech ranks among the nation's top 20 universities for research and development spending and No. 1 among institutions without a medical school.


**Georgia Tech's Mission and Values**
  

Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do:


1\. Students are our top priority.
  

2\. We strive for excellence.
  

3\. We thrive on diversity.
  

4\. We celebrate collaboration.
  

5\. We champion innovation.
  

6\. We safeguard freedom of inquiry and expression.
  

7\. We nurture the wellbeing of our community.
  

8\. We act ethically.


9\. We are responsible stewards.


Over the next decade, Georgia Tech will become an example of inclusive innovation, a leading technological research university of unmatched scale, relentlessly committed to serving the public good; breaking new ground in addressing the biggest local, national, and global challenges and opportunities of our time; making technology broadly accessible; and developing exceptional, principled leaders from all backgrounds ready to produce novel ideas and create solutions with real human impact.


**About the School of Civil \& Environmental Engineering at the Georgia Institute of Technology**
  

The School of Civil and Environmental Engineering at Georgia Tech currently has over 650 undergraduate students, nearly 320 graduate students, 55 tenure\-track faculty members, and 4 Professors of the Practice. Women comprise 50% of the undergraduate population, and more than 29% of the undergraduate student population identifies as a member of under\-represented minority groups. Thirteen faculty members are women, and eight faculty members identify as a member of under\-represented minority groups. Twenty\-six faculty members hold endowed chairs or professorships with 30% of them being women faculty. The School's Strategic Vision is available at www.ce.gatech.edu/strategic\-vision. The corresponding graduate programs are ranked \#3 and \#4, respectively.


We are a vibrant and intellectually diverse School, with people who are using new technologies to expand the notion of what it means to be civil and environmental engineers in the 21st Century. This position is out of **West Town Senior Satellite Center.** **Fit \& Strong! information**: Fit \& Strong! is a group physical activity and behavior change program for persons with arthritis. The program consists of 24 sessions each lasting 90 minutes. The first 60 minutes focus on flexibility, low\-impact aerobics, and strength training to improve lower body function. The remaining 30 minutes consist of health education and group problem solving using a structured curriculum. Participants develop personalized action plans to maintain physical activity and progress after the class ends. Fit \& Strong! is effective, engaging, and fun – the program has high retention and attendance rates.
Fit \& Strong! is currently offered by community sites across 32 states \+ DC. Fit \& Strong! is recommended by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), the National Council on Aging, the American Physical Therapy Association, and is a Research Tested Intervention Program evaluated by the National Cancer Institute/NIH.
Read more about Fit \& Strong! here: https://fitandstrong.uic.edu/

---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!
